## arc_1044 — Honest-exit DIVERSIFICATION: does the book beat me_long SOLO? (3rd deploy pillar)

**Question.** The diversification pillar (arc 2019, ENB 3.32/4 "~3 independent bets") is the structural
justification for the 4-leg programme, computed on COMMITTED exits. arc 1042/1043 showed honest exits
halve the deploy mean and remove its significance, with 2 of 4 legs going negative and me_long the lone
robust leg. Sharpest honest test: **does the 4-way book beat me_long SOLO on a risk-adjusted basis
under honest §5f exits, or does the portfolio collapse to one thin leg?**

**Method.** Canonical scoring; honest §5f series (BUILT `nested_exit_selection`, 3 metrics);
honest-refit RP weights (`combine_fold_roi`). Fold-bootstrap (seed 42, N=10000) me_long-SOLO vs 4-way
BOOK (mean/sd/t/fold-Sharpe). Honest ENB = (Σλ)²/Σλ² of the 4-leg fold-ROI covariance (arc-2019
method) + pairwise corr. OOS untouched.

**Honest ENB collapses 3.32 → ~1.8/4** (1.41 mean_roi / 1.93 afp / 1.77 worst) — the diversification
pillar is exit-optimistic too, roughly halved (honest book ≈ 1.5–2 independent bets, not ~3.3).

**Book vs me_long-SOLO (honest-refit RP, ~0.55 me_long):**
| honest metric | SOLO (mean/Sharpe/t) | BOOK (mean/Sharpe/t) | verdict | ENB |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mean_roi | +0.217%/+0.307/+0.97 | +0.156%/+0.262/+0.83 | **SOLO ≥ book** | 1.41 |
| afp_then_mean | +0.217%/+0.307/+0.97 | +0.347%/+0.437/+1.38 | **BOOK > solo** | 1.93 |
| worst_then_mean | +0.170%/+0.286/+0.90 | +0.285%/+0.481/+1.52 | **BOOK > solo** | 1.77 |

Under the conservative metrics (afp/worst, which held OOS in 1042) the honest book BEATS me_long-solo
on Sharpe (+0.44–0.48 vs +0.29–0.31) — the load-bearing diversifier is **fbr** (honest fold-ROI corr
**−0.44 to −0.65** with me_long; gap+me_short are individually negative-mean but their decorrelation
cuts book variance more than it drags the mean) → the book is **NOT reducible to "just me_long."** Under
mean_roi (the §5f-trap exit) the book is WORSE than solo (+0.262 vs +0.307) — so even "book > solo" is
exit-metric-dependent. me_long-solo is itself non-significant (t≈0.9), consistent with 1043.

**Verdict: DIAGNOSTIC → KILL** (no new component; components UNCHANGED). The portfolio thesis SURVIVES
in WEAKENED, exit-metric-dependent form: ENB halved (3.32→~1.8), modest real Sharpe lift over the core
leg under trustworthy exits (NOT pure-me_long), reverses under the optimistic metric, still
non-significant. **Completes the honest-exit correction of all three magnitude/significance/
diversification pillars** (mean 1042 ~2× high, significance 1043 lost, ENB 1044 ~2× high) — each
materially weaker honest, none fully collapses; the honest deploy object is a thin ~1.8-bet,
non-significant, +0.27%/yr book carried by me_long + decorrelated fbr.

**ROLL-UP FLAG (operator-facing):** the committed-exit deploy characterization (arcs
2016/2017/2019/1023/2021/3022) is SYSTEMATICALLY exit-optimistic — deploy mean ~2× too high
(+0.59→+0.27%), significance lost (t 2.16→~1.3, CI spans zero), effective bets ~2× too high (3.32→~1.8).
Remaining un-rechecked committed-exit pillars = temporal stability (2021) + cost cushion (3022 κ=3.32);
both owed an honest re-run, though cost cushion likely just halves (no qualitative flip — honest book
is net-positive at κ=1). Path-A is the operator's call on a WEAKER object than the committed arcs
advertised.

**NEW lesson.** Honest §5f exits roughly HALVE a thin book's effective-bet count (ENB 3.32→~1.8) — the
diversification pillar is exit-optimistic too — BUT the book is NOT reducible to its one robust leg: a
decorrelated, individually-negative-mean leg (fbr, corr −0.44…−0.65 with me_long) can still lift
risk-adjusted return over the solo leg because variance reduction outweighs mean drag. "2 of 4 legs go
negative" weakens but does not necessarily collapse the multi-leg thesis — judge the honest book on
Sharpe, not just mean.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (reused `nested_exit_selection` + `combine_fold_roi`). Driver
`_disco_work/arc1044_honest_diversification.py`. No canonical change, no council, OOS untouched.

**Convergence note (arc 1043 ↔ concurrent arc 2043, 2000s).** Independent arc 2043 (2000s chat,
different weighting — arc-2016 weights {gap 0, me_long .65, fbr .2, me_short .15}) ran the SAME
honest-book significance recompute concurrently and CONVERGES: committed t=+2.66 (reproduces arc 1023
EXACTLY at those weights), honest **NOT significant (best t≈0.96, all CIs span zero, P(mean≤0)
0.15–0.49).** With my arc 1043 (risk-parity weights, committed t=+2.16 / honest t≈1.2–1.5) this is a
TWO-CHAT, TWO-WEIGHTING independent confirmation that arc-1023/2019's t=2.66 significance pillar does
NOT survive honest §5f exits — the strongest possible Arc-10 cross-check on the deploy-case correction.
My arc 1044 extends the thread to the diversification pillar (honest ENB 3.32→~1.8), not duplicated by
the 2000s chat.

### arc_1045 — Honest-exit 2-way {me_long + fbr}: is the clean pair a better deploy object than the 4-way?

**Because.** My arcs 1042/1043/1044 (+ 2000s 2040–2043) established the §5f exit-honesty correction of the
4-way book's deploy pillars: under honest nested-WFO exit selection gap + me_short flip mean-NEGATIVE
(their committed exits were full-sample-best picks), fbr takes a ~40% haircut but stays + and is the
load-bearing diversifier (honest corr −0.44…−0.65 with me_long), and me_long is exit-robust. arc 1044
compared the 4-way vs me_long-SOLO and stopped. The object sitting exactly between them was never tested:
the **2-way {me_long + fbr}** — the two robust, most-anti-correlated legs, which also happen to carry the
two binding folds (me_long 2018 +0.90, fbr 2015 +3.17). A negative-mean leg only earns its book seat if
its decorrelation benefit exceeds its mean drag; under honest exits that is now in doubt for gap +
me_short. So: does DROPPING them and keeping the clean pair IMPROVE the book? (2006 tested gap+me_long;
2008/3009/1015 the 3-way incl. gap; the gap=0 edge of 2008's committed convex search is closest but never
on the honest §5f series, never as the headline deploy candidate, never with the Sharpe/significance
comparison.) Also a cheap orientation check this arc: the data corpus is **pure FX** (28 majors/crosses,
verified `histdata_backup` — no metals/indices), so the "instrument-universe-beyond-FX" lever is closed by
data availability; closed-ground stands.

**Method.** 100% canonical scoring (`ArcFoldRunner`→`A1Architecture`→`MultiPairBacktester`, FundedNext);
honest §5f per-leg series via BUILT `nested_exit_selection` (3 metrics); book combination via BUILT
`combine_fold_roi` (equal / risk-parity / full convex w_me∈[0,1] scan). Crucial correctness point: I use
the **EVALUABLE (non-warmup) folds only** — 8 folds 2013-2020; the 2 warmup folds (2011/2012) get the
global frozen pick (a lookahead taint) so they are dropped, per arc 2043. Both the 2-way AND the 4-way are
scored on the SAME 8 evaluable folds → the comparison is apples-to-apples honest, and this also corrects
arc 1044 (which mixed the 2 warmup folds into its bootstrap, inflating its 4-way numbers vs mine). Driver
`_disco_work/arc1045_honest_2way_melong_fbr.py`. No new tool, no canonical change, OOS untouched.

**Result 1 — NOT all-folds-positive (KILL on the gate).** The convex w_me scan finds NO weighting that
clears AFP under any metric (best worst-fold −0.641% / −0.209% / −0.217%). The binding folds are **2014**
(BOTH legs mildly negative — me_long −0.23, fbr −0.14 — fundamentally unrescuable by a 2-leg book) and the
**2015↔2018 mutual-exclusion** (2015 positive ONLY via fbr-heavy +3.5; 2018 positive ONLY via me_long-heavy
+0.90 while fbr is −3.4 — opposite weight demands, neither solo AFP). This is the same leg-count-INVARIANT
wall the 4-way (2008/3009/1015) hit — trimming legs does not fix it.

**Result 2 — but the 2-way is a MATERIALLY BETTER deploy object than the 4-way.** Honest §5f, 8 evaluable
folds, RP weighting:

| object | metric | mean | Sharpe(fold) | t | P(mean<0) | 95% CI | neg |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| me_long SOLO | afp | +0.203% | +0.31 | +0.72 | 0.219 | [−0.34,+0.69] | 3/8 |
| 4-way BOOK (RP) | afp | +0.096% | +0.14 | +0.39 | 0.333 | [−0.37,+0.51] | 3/8 |
| **2-way me_long+fbr (RP, w_me 0.74)** | **afp** | **+0.411%** | **+0.75** | **+2.12** | **0.008** | **[+0.07,+0.77]** | 2/8 |
| 4-way BOOK (RP) | worst | +0.120% | +0.20 | +0.57 | 0.278 | [−0.26,+0.51] | 4/8 |
| **2-way me_long+fbr (RP, w_me 0.80)** | **worst** | **+0.357%** | **+0.69** | **+1.95** | **0.015** | **[+0.02,+0.69]** | 3/8 |
| **2-way me_long+fbr (RP, w_me 0.94)** | **mean_roi** | **+0.398%** | **+0.66** | **+1.87** | **0.032** | **[−0.03,+0.73]** | 1/8 |

~2× the Sharpe of the 4-way under every metric, and it **recovers the statistical significance the honest
4-way LOST** (arc 1043: honest 4-way t≈1.3, CI spans zero): the afp-metric 2-way RP is t=+2.12,
P(mean<0)=0.008, CI=[+0.07,+0.77] excluding zero (worst metric likewise excludes zero). **gap + me_short
are NET DRAGS under honest exits** — adding them to the clean 2-way HALVES the Sharpe and kills the
significance; their negative honest mean outweighs their decorrelation benefit. ALL the real
diversification is the single me_long↔fbr anti-correlation (−0.54…−0.68). This sharpens arc 1044's "not
reducible to just me_long" to its exact form: **the honest book IS reducible to me_long + fbr; the other
two legs subtract.** (Mechanically, RP heavily down-weights the volatile fbr — sd 2.3–12.2 vs me_long 0.7
— to a 0.06–0.26 sleeve, so the 2-way is "me_long + a small decorrelating fbr sleeve," and that sleeve is
what lifts the non-significant me_long-solo to significant.)

**Honesty caveats (§8, Arc-10 defense).** (1) The significance is **weighting- and metric-dependent**: the
equal-weight 2-way is positive but NOT significant (afp t=+1.76, CI=[−0.04,+1.18] spans zero); it appears
under RP weighting. RP is a principled no-fold-sign-lookahead inverse-vol weighting (legit), but the result
is borderline at n=8 — NOT a robust >2σ claim. (2) **IS only — OOS untouched.** The 2-way fails IS AFP, so
the §5g combined-book holdout firewall (1042/2043) blocks an OOS book gate, consistent with every recent
book arc. A real deploy claim for the 2-way needs it frozen (weights + per-leg §5f-frozen exits) and scored
ONCE on OOS — an explicit OWED operator/§5g step, not done here.

**Verdict: DIAGNOSTIC → KILL** (no new component; 2-way not AFP). Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO).
**FLAG (operator path-A, docs only): the honest deploy object is the 2-way {me_long + fbr} at risk-parity,
NOT the 4-way** — ~2× Sharpe, recovers borderline significance the 4-way lost, fewer neg folds; **drop gap
+ me_short for the honest-exit deploy** (they net-subtract). This partially REVERSES the implicit "deploy
all 4 legs" framing of the committed-exit characterization (2016/2019/1023). The discovery AFP gate verdict
is unchanged.

**NEW lesson.** After the §5f exit correction, RE-SELECT a thin book's leg SET, not just its weights — a
leg whose committed headline was a full-sample-best exit pick can go mean-negative under honest exits, and
then its decorrelation no longer pays for its mean drag, so it SUBTRACTS. Trimming to the two robust
anti-correlated legs DOUBLED the honest book Sharpe and recovered the significance the full 4-way lost,
yet the trimmed book stayed NOT-all-folds-positive (2014 + the 2015↔2018 mutual-exclusion are
leg-count-invariant). A Sharpe/significance gain from trimming is real and deploy-relevant even when the
AFP gate verdict is unchanged.

**Threads.** (i) The OWED 2-way OOS book confirmation (freeze RP weights + each leg's §5f-frozen exit,
score 2021+ ONCE) — operator/§5g, the one remaining honest measurement for the 2-way deploy case. (ii) The
roll-up of un-rechecked committed-exit pillars (temporal 2021, cost κ 3022) still stands from arc 1044 —
but those are now secondary to the leg-SET correction this arc surfaces. (iii) 2014 emerged as a NEW
binding fold for the 2-leg book (both legs mildly negative) — a small all-fold-positive book would need a
3rd leg positive in 2014 AND 2018 AND not destroying 2015, which is the same unfound regime-orthogonal
component (the 2018 wall) plus a 2014 constraint.

### arc_2045 — Deployment GEOMETRY of the honest 2-leg (me_long+fbr) book (independent reproduction of arc 1045)
**Why this arc.** arc 2044 established the honest deploy OBJECT is the 2-leg me_long+fbr (under §5f exits
gap & me_short flip mean-negative → drag; the honest 4-leg book is mean-dragged below its 2 honest legs).
But arc 1033/2033 proved deployability is GEOMETRY-bound (Calmar / time-underwater / prop-firm
feasibility, NOT depth or per-year sign) and profiled that geometry only for the COMMITTED 4-leg. The
missing operator input: the honest deploy object's actual deployment geometry. (Concurrently the 1000s
chat ran the same 2-leg idea, arc 1045 — independent reproduction; mine adds the geometry axis they
didn't compute, theirs added the Sharpe/significance/AFP-scan I didn't.)

**Method.** 100% canonical scoring; fbr's FROZEN honest §5f exit via BUILT
`nested_exit_selection.freeze_best_over_folds` (the deployable single config — afp/worst metrics both
freeze `sl_partial_close_1r_runner_trail`/SL1.5, IS +1.477%; mean_roi freezes the high-variance
trailing_swing §5f trap → not deploy). Contiguous co-sim via canonical `cosim_book_fold` (reusing
`equity_risk_profile._build_4way_contiguous`'s pattern, specialized to 2 legs + per-year-reset re-id);
geometry via BUILT `compute_risk_profile`; vehicle feasibility via BUILT `propfirm_feasibility`. me_long
per-year ROIs reproduce the committed record (max dev 0.004pp = anchor). OOS untouched.

**Findings.** (1) The honest 2-leg book per-fold (RP) = mean +0.549%, t=2.74, 8/10, worst −0.251% (2015)
— the **shallowest book worst-fold in the corpus** but **still not all-folds-positive** (2015 & 2016
marginally negative; arc 1045's convex scan independently finds NO AFP weighting, binding 2014 +
2015↔2018). (2) **DEPLOYMENT GEOMETRY ≈ UNCHANGED vs the committed 4-leg** — honest 2-leg RP cap-ON
(faithful) maxDD 1.559% / Calmar 0.245 / underwater 1999d (99%) / prop-firm T_min 4.08yr, vs committed
4-leg maxDD 1.59% / Calmar 0.24-0.36 / ~4.7yr / T_min 1.4-8.4yr. Dropping the 2 drag legs + honest exits
does NOT break arc-2033's vehicle wall (daily 5% cap never breached; T_min stays YEARS vs the
weeks-months a challenge expects). (3) But the 2-way DOES improve STATISTICAL QUALITY — ~2× Sharpe (RP
cap-OFF 0.459 / cap-ON 0.305 vs the honest 4-way's ~0.13-0.20) and recovers borderline significance the
honest 4-way had lost (my frozen t=2.74; arc-1045 nested t=2.12, CI [+0.07,+0.77] excludes zero) —
because gap+me_short were net-SUBTRACTING (mean-negativity outweighed decorrelation).

**Arc-10 self-correction (why independent reproduction matters).** My first draft over-cautiously claimed
the 2-way significance "collapses to ~1 under the nested reading" (wrongly extrapolating the 4-way
mechanism). The concurrent arc 1045 computed the nested 2-way directly and got t=+2.12 (CI excludes zero)
— the 2-way RECOVERS significance, it doesn't lose it. I corrected the doc. Both numbers (my frozen 2.74,
1045's nested 2.12) agree: the 2-way is borderline-significant (RP/metric-dependent, not robust >2σ),
~2× the honest 4-way.

**Verdict — DIAGNOSTIC → KILL** (no new component; me_long & fbr stay PORTFOLIO; the 2-way is a subset,
still not AFP → no survivor). The synthesis: trimming a thin geometry-bound book to its honest
exit-robust core fixes the Sharpe/significance axis (~2×, recovers borderline sig) but NOT the
Calmar/vehicle-feasibility axis (the drag legs added mean-NOISE, not drawdown DURATION) — so the honest
2-leg is the right deploy FRAMING and a real statistical-quality win, but not a deployability FIX. The
operator's only viable deployment of this book remains low-risk already-funded capital as a slow
~0.4-0.6%/yr diversifier; a prop-firm challenge stays infeasible (Calmar-bound, arc 2033). FLAG (docs
only): deploy the 2-way {me_long+fbr} at risk-parity, drop gap+me_short; also re-confirms arc-2040 F2
(the deployable honest-exit fbr differs from the §11-audited committed-trail variant → small owed outcome
re-derivation). The honest-exit thread is now complete on every axis (mean 1042 / sig 2043·1043 /
diversification 2044·1044 / temporal 2044 / cost 2044 / 2-way deploy object 2045·1045).

**NEW lesson.** A thin geometry-bound book has two near-independent quality axes: the vol-adjusted
(Sharpe/significance) and the DD-adjusted (Calmar/vehicle-feasibility). Pruning to the honest
exit-robust leg subset — dropping legs that went mean-negative under §5f and now net-subtract — fixes the
FIRST axis (~2× Sharpe, recovers the significance the full book lost) but leaves the SECOND unchanged
(the drag legs added mean-noise, not the drawdown duration that sets Calmar). So "simplify to the honest
core" is the correct deploy FRAMING and a genuine statistical-quality gain, yet not a deployability FIX —
the vehicle wall is invariant to leg-count. Recompute BOTH axes when trimming a book.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (reused `nested_exit_selection` 2040 + `combine_fold_roi` 2006 +
`cosim_book_fold` canonical + `compute_risk_profile` 1033 + `propfirm_feasibility` 2033). Driver
`_disco_work/arc2045_honest_2leg_geometry.py`, output `_disco_work/arc2045_out.txt`. No canonical change,
no council, OOS untouched. Converges with arc 1045 (1000s, independent).

### arc_1046 — Honest frozen-exit OOS: does the 2-way {me_long+fbr} beat the 4-way out-of-sample?

**Because.** Direct continuation of my arc 1045 (IS): the clean 2-way {me_long+fbr} is a materially better
honest deploy object than the 4-way (~2× Sharpe, recovers the significance the honest 4-way lost), because
gap + me_short flip mean-negative under honest §5f exits and all the real diversification is the
me_long↔fbr anti-correlation (−0.57). That finding was independently reproduced IS by the concurrent 2000s
arcs 2044/2045 — but ALL THREE of us (1045 + 2044/2045) left it IS-only (2044/2045 explicitly preserved
OOS). 1045's own FLAG named the gap: "a frozen-weight + frozen-exit one-shot OOS book confirmation is
OWED." This arc discharges exactly that owed check. The OOS is the only thing that can confirm or break the
"deploy the 2-way" recommendation.

**Method.** Canonical scoring on IS folds (2011-2020) AND `build_oos_year_folds(2021)` (2021-2026, 6
holdout years). §5f FROZEN discipline: per leg, per metric, `nested_exit_selection.freeze_best_over_folds`
picks the exit best over ALL IS (the holdout freeze); RP weights fit on the IS honest evaluable series,
FROZEN; both applied to the OOS grid; combined → 2-way + 4-way OOS books vs me_long-solo OOS. Nothing
selected on OOS — it is measured ONCE as characterization (arc-1042 precedent), not a §5g gate, and not
tuned (so the holdout is not spent, §4). Driver `_disco_work/arc1046_honest_2way_oos.py`.

**Result — two findings, one robust and one a surprise inversion.**

*(1) ROBUST: the 2-way beats the 4-way OOS, every metric.* 2-way OOS Sharpe +0.27 / +0.46 / +0.46 vs 4-way
−0.04 / +0.20 / +0.22; under the mean_roi metric the 4-way is mean-NEGATIVE OOS (−0.039%) while the 2-way
holds +0.262%. So arc-1045/2045's "drop gap + me_short" is durable — those two exit-artifact legs are net
drags IS *and* OOS.

*(2) SURPRISE: the IS Sharpe ranking inverts OOS — me_long SOLO beats the 2-way.* Solo OOS mean +0.449 /
+0.449 / +0.334, Sharpe +0.53 / +0.53 / +0.51, only 1/6 neg; the 2-way is +0.26 / +0.40 / +0.32, Sharpe
+0.27 / +0.46 / +0.46, 3/6 neg. fbr — the IS diversifier — is mean-NEGATIVE OOS under its own frozen exit
(afp partial-runner per-year: 2021 −0.54, 2022 −0.00, 2023 −1.18, 2024 +5.33, 2025 −1.57, 2026 −0.44;
−9.5 in 2021 under the mean_roi trailing_swing pick). Its IS −0.57 anti-correlation with me_long lifted the
2-way IS Sharpe above solo (1045), but OOS that benefit reverses: adding fbr INTRODUCES negative folds
(2023, 2026) me_long alone did not have. The decorrelation can't pay once the leg's OOS mean is negative.
fbr's OOS-negativity is robust to the exit choice (negative under BOTH frozen exits), not a trailing_swing
artifact — consistent with arc 1013's thin OOS (+0.94%, 3/6) and arc 2040's fished-exit-dies-OOS.

*Net.* Under honest frozen exits scored on the holdout, the entire 4-component portfolio's deploy value
collapses to its single robust leg, me_long — the only component positive under BOTH its IS-robust exit
(1042/2042) AND OOS (here): +0.33–0.45%/yr, Sharpe ~0.51–0.53, 5/6 OOS years positive (only 2021 neg).
me_long is NOT AFP (2021 OOS neg + 3/8 IS neg) → it stays a PORTFOLIO component, not a survivor/PASS.

**Caveats (§8).** n=6 OOS years is small; me_long-solo OOS t≈1.3, P(mean<0)≈0.06–0.08 — borderline, NOT
significant at 0.05. One honest frozen read; OOS not tuned (not spent, §4). me_long-solo not AFP → no §5g
pass claimed. The robust half (drop gap/me_short) holds both ways; the fragile half (fbr adds value) was
IS-only.

**Verdict: DIAGNOSTIC → KILL** (no new component; nothing reaches AFP). me_long + the other 3 components
UNCHANGED. The 1045 IS finding is resolved on the holdout with a sharper, partly-inverted answer.

**FLAG (operator path-A, sharpens 1045/2045).** Durable: drop gap + me_short (2-way > 4-way IS+OOS). But
the honest, OOS-validated deploy CORE is me_long SOLO, not the 2-way — fbr's IS-diversification does NOT
survive the holdout (mean-negative OOS), so adding it to me_long hurts OOS. The multi-component PORTFOLIO
thesis (the structural justification for 4 legs, arcs 1006→2019) does NOT survive honest frozen exits +
OOS: the path-A deploy object is a single thin PORTFOLIO leg (me_long, ~+0.4%/yr, Sharpe ~0.5, borderline-
significant, not AFP), not a 4-bet (1044) or 2-bet (1045/2045) book.

**Convergence note (arc 1045/2044/2045 ↔ 1046).** The 1000s (1045) and 2000s (2044/2045) chats
independently reproduced the IS result (2-way is the better deploy object; gap+me_short net-subtract;
recovers significance t≈2.1) — strong Arc-10 cross-confirmation on the IS axis. This arc adds the axis all
three left open: the FROZEN-exit OOS, which both confirms the robust half (2-way > 4-way) and reveals the
inversion the IS view could not see (me_long-solo > 2-way OOS; fbr's IS-diversification dies on the
holdout). The honest, OOS-validated endpoint of the whole honest-exit thread (1042→2045) is: the deploy
object is me_long.

**NEW lesson.** An IS diversification benefit can REVERSE out-of-sample when the diversifying leg is
mean-negative on the holdout: a −corr leg only helps if its OOS mean is also non-negative. Judge a
diversifier on whether its OOS MEAN survives, not just its IS correlation; re-derive a thin multi-leg
book's deploy ranking on the FROZEN holdout before trusting an IS Sharpe ranking — here it collapsed a
4-leg "portfolio" to one robust leg (me_long).

**Threads / handoff.** The honest-exit deploy thread (1042→1046, 2040→2045) is now closed on every axis
(mean / significance / diversification / temporal / cost / 2-way deploy object / OOS): the endpoint is
me_long-solo as the lone honest OOS-robust PORTFOLIO leg, borderline-significant, not AFP, vehicle-
infeasible (arc 2033/2045 geometry wall). Open frontier for a fresh chat: (i) the 2018/2014 regime-
orthogonal component remains unfound across ~18 routes — the only path to an AFP book; (ii) all
single-condition shallow directional (long+short) + the FX instrument universe are closed (this arc
verified the corpus is pure FX). A genuinely novel mechanism with a documented *because* is the only
remaining edge lane.
## arc_2046 — §11 OUTCOME audit of the honest-DEPLOY fbr exit (partial-runner/SL1.5)

**What this is.** The §11 outcome programme (2036/1038 fbr, 2037 gap+me_long, 2038/1039 me_short,
2039 cost) verified the COMMITTED book. But the §5f exit-honesty thread (2040→2045) re-identified the
deployable object as the 2-leg {me_long+fbr} where **fbr's honest deploy exit is a DIFFERENT config**

## arc_2047 — Survival-filtered swing-HIGH breakout CONTINUATION long (does fbr's load-bearing filter work on the continuation side?)

**Because.** Full record: [`arcs/arc_2047_survival_breakout_continuation.md`](arcs/arc_2047_survival_breakout_continuation.md). The honest-exit deploy thread (1042→1046, 2040→2046) is closed: the 4-component book collapses OOS to me_long-solo, not AFP; the binding wall is the 2014 + 2015↔2018 strong-USD regime, and a 2014/2018-positive regime-orthogonal component is the only path to an AFP book (unfound across ~18 routes). My prior chat's last arc (2029) established the fresh insight that **swing-SURVIVAL significance is fbr's load-bearing feature** — but only ever tested on the *reversal* side. The corpus's breakouts (Donchian 1001/1002/1003) used RAW N-bar highs, never the survival filter. The never-tested continuation analog: a decisive close ABOVE a long-*surviving* swing high (genuine resistance, concentrated breakout-stops). *because:* a confirmed break of significant resistance should trigger the stops + signal demand → continue, and in strong-USD trends (2014/2015/2018) should persist → positive where the reversion book bleeds. Falsifiable: capture must beat baseline (~0.4877) AND a same-momentum-not-at-a-surviving-high control, ideally 2014/2018-positive.

**Method.** H4, 7 USD majors (fbr's universe), IS 2010-2020 + OOS measured (not tuned). Ex-ante surviving high = `high_ask.shift(1).rolling(K).max()`, K∈{20,40,60}; breakout fire = body `(close_mid−open_mid)/ATR≥1.0` & `high_ask>prior_high` (pierced) & `close_mid>prior_high` (confirmed close above); control = same big-up bar NOT at a surviving high. Honest +1R capture + 24-bar drift via canonical `observe_long_capture` (gross, characterization only). Driver `_disco_work/arc2047_survival_breakout_obs.py` (scratch).

**FALSIFIED four ways (pooled 7 majors; baseline ≈0.4877).** (1) **Coin-flip capture** ~0.49-0.50 at every K (breakout K20 0.4953 / K40 0.4976 / K60 0.4889). (2) **breakout ≈ control** — K40 0.4976 vs 0.4958; K20 0.4953 vs 0.4960 → the swing-survival structure is **NOT load-bearing for the continuation**, the decisive control failure (vs fbr's reversal where AT-swing-low 0.52-0.61 ≫ same-wick-elsewhere coin-flip). (3) **Drift NEGATIVE, deeper-survival WORSE** — −0.03→−0.14 ATR; K=60 (most-significant levels) reverts most (cap 0.4889 below baseline). (4) **NOT 2014/2018-positive** — breakout K40 per-year: **2014 cap 0.4398** (among the worst, the key blocker), 2016 0.4368/drift −1.15 (catastrophic), 2018 0.4821/+0.17 (mild); per-pair 4/7 sub-0.50, the one tail USDJPY 0.556 = arc-2011/3011 pair-mix.

**Why it fails (mechanism).** Swing-survival significance is load-bearing ONLY for the FORWARD-confirming reversal, not the BACKWARD-confirming continuation — the breakOUT-side completion of arc 1014's reclaim-vs-breakdown finding. fbr works because the reclaim is forward-confirming: at entry the down-move is over and the up-move hasn't started, so i+1 enters before it. A confirmed break of a surviving high is backward-confirming: the bar that closes above the level IS the stop-run — the resting breakout-stops are already triggered by the breakout bar, so nothing fuels continuation, and i+1 buys AFTER the displacement, at the exhaustion high that mildly reverts (same i+1-enters-the-extreme problem as 1014's confirmed-breakdown short / 2001's gap entry). A surviving level is a dense resting-liquidity pool whose grab-and-reclaim reverts (fbr); a break SPENDS that liquidity rather than inheriting an edge. The survival filter does not transfer reversal→continuation.

**Verdict: KILL (obs cheap-kill, §5d).** Coin-flip entry (≈ control, negative drift) → §5f does not bite (no non-coin-flip entry to put on the engine); no engine/null/council spent (matches 2016/2027/2028/2029/1014). Closes the most natural continuation extension of the corpus's one directional win: survival-filtered breakout continuation is not a continuation-side fbr. STRENGTHENS the unified theory — sharpens 2029's "swing-survival is load-bearing" to its exact scope (forward-confirming reversal ONLY) and re-confirms arc 1014's forward-vs-backward-confirming distinction on the breakout side. The 2014/2018 regime-orthogonal component remains unfound; every structural-direction lane (reversal + continuation, long + short) is now mapped to coin-flip — if a 2018 component exists it is not a directional-structure leg. Components UNCHANGED (deploy core = me_long-solo, 1046). Deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** A filter proven load-bearing for one direction-of-confirmation does NOT transfer to its opposite: swing-survival significance makes the *forward-confirming* grab-reversal (fbr) work but adds nothing to the *backward-confirming* break (continuation ≈ control coin-flip). The discriminator is WHERE i+1 enters relative to the move — before it starts (reclaim) vs after it completes (confirmed break) — not the level's significance. Continuation structure on liquid FX H4 stays coin-flip even with the corpus's best structural filter bolted on.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool — canonical `Panel.from_pairs`, `observe_long_capture`, BUILT `_atr_shift1_mid` only; no TOOL_REGISTRY append (inline scratch obs, matching 2027/2028/2029). **FLAGS:** none (no canonical change). Driver `_disco_work/arc2047_survival_breakout_obs.py` (scratch, not committed).
### arc_1047 — FX intraday SESSION seasonality (Ranaldo 2009): local-hours depreciation

**Because.** The honest-exit deploy thread (1042→1046, 2040→2046) is closed on every axis — the deploy
object collapses to me_long-solo, not AFP, vehicle-infeasible; the §11 audits are complete. The two open
lanes (arc-1046 handoff) are (i) the 2018/2014 regime-orthogonal component (unfound across ~18 routes) and
(ii) a genuinely novel mechanism with a documented *because*. The survivor DNA is **a LARGE forced
dislocation → reversion big enough to clear cost** (gap >0.5ATR, month-end >1ATR, stop-run shadow
>1.25ATR); the dead intraday flow effects (gotobi 1008, round-no 1010, daily-fix 3008) were *small
continuous* effects ≈ cost. The one named-untested microstructure lane in the closed-ground frontier #3 is
**session / local-hours flow**: Ranaldo 2009 documents that a currency systematically DEPRECIATES during
its own local trading hours (dealer-inventory + settlement flow). As a signal it is decorrelated-by-
construction from the trend/reversion regime → candidate regime-orthogonal (2018-positive) intraday leg.
Explicit cost-skeptical prior: this is the *small continuous* class the corpus arbitraged-to-cost; so the
arc is a fast honest characterization, cheap-kill if it can't clear cost.

**Method (observation only; no engine/P&L).** Driver `_disco_work/arc1047_ranaldo_session.py`. 8 H1-cached
pairs (EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/USDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY/AUDJPY/EURGBP — span EUR/GBP/USD/JPY/AUD), `Panel.from_pairs`,
2010-2026 (~100k H1 bars/pair). Per-pair hour-of-day (UTC) mean log-return → currency-strength-by-hour
(pair return = +base/−quote) → Ranaldo local-vs-foreign test → per-year **net-of-cost** cumulative-local-
session move for the matching currencies. Cost ref: median raw spread 0.99 bp; FundedNext round-trip ~1.88
bp (1.5× spread + ~0.4 bp slip/comm proxy).

**Finding 1 — the mechanism is REAL and in-sign for EUR/GBP/USD into 2010-2026.** Local-hours mean vs
foreign-hours mean (bp/hr; Ranaldo: local<0<foreign): EUR −0.158/+0.101 (diff +0.259), GBP −0.072/+0.055
(+0.127), USD −0.059/+0.082 (+0.141) — all match (currency weak at home). **JPY INVERTS** (+0.096 local /
−0.106 foreign — Tokyo-hours JPY *buying*, plausibly fixing/carry desks), **AUD flat** (−0.035). A genuine
confirmation the effect survives in modern data for the European/USD currencies.

**Finding 2 — SUB-COST.** Directly-tradeable gross edge = cumulative local-session move (short the
currency over its weak hours, 1 RT). Best case EUR: −0.158 bp/hr × 9h ≈ **1.42 bp gross < 1.88 bp cost** →
net negative; GBP/USD weaker; no single-hour cell clears cost (all per-hour |strength| < 1 bp). The
corpus's repeated intraday-flow result (1008/1010/3008).

**Finding 3 — UNSTABLE + NOT the 2018 leg (regime-DEPENDENT, the decisive kill).** Per-year net-of-cost,
net-positive years / 17 (2010-2026): **EUR 7/17** (best — worse than coin-flip; inverts 2022 & 2025), GBP
3/17, USD 4/17. 2018 specifically: EUR net +1.64 but GBP −0.34 and **USD −4.09** — the USD local-
depreciation flow **inverts in 2018** because it's a strong-USD risk-off year (USD *bought* in NY hours,
trend overwhelms settlement flow). So the session effect is **regime-DEPENDENT, not regime-orthogonal**: it
fails in exactly the trending/risk-off years the portfolio's 2018 leg would need — the same failure mode as
every other route.

**Verdict — KILL (obs cheap-kill).** Real, documented mechanism, in-sign for EUR/GBP/USD, but (1) sub-cost
(~1.4 bp gross < 1.88 bp), (2) unstable (best ccy 7/17 net-pos), (3) regime-dependent (USD inverts in
2018). The §5f nested-exit step cannot bite: the directly-tradeable *gross* capture is already below cost,
so no exit choice rescues it (the "exit" is the session close; cumulative session move < cost) — same class
as 1008/1010/3008. No engine/null/council spent (3003 lesson #2: don't spend the engine on a sub-cost
coin-flip-grade base). OOS never touched. No new component, no canonical change.

**NEW lesson.** FX intraday session seasonality (Ranaldo's local-hours depreciation) is still *present in
sign* for EUR/GBP/USD in 2010-2026 but its magnitude (~1-2 bp/session) sits at/below the FundedNext cost
line, AND it **inverts in trending/risk-off regimes** (USD bought-at-home in 2018) — so it is neither
capturable nor regime-orthogonal. Extends the corpus "small continuous intraday flow ≈ cost, arbitraged"
finding to the **session/time-of-day** axis, and adds that the residual flow is itself *regime-conditional*
(overwhelmed by trend in the exact years a 2018 leg needs) — the session lane is NOT a back-door to the
regime-orthogonal component.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (pure observation over `Panel.from_pairs` + numpy). Driver
`_disco_work/arc1047_ranaldo_session.py`. No canonical change, no council, OOS untouched.

**Threads / handoff.** The 2018/2014 regime-orthogonal component remains unfound (now ~19 dead routes);
the session/time-of-day microstructure lane is closed (sub-cost + regime-dependent). Instrument universe
re-confirmed pure-FX (no metals/indices in `histdata_backup`). A genuinely novel mechanism with a
documented *because* remains the only edge lane.

### arc_1048 — NFP-day (first-Friday) overreaction REVERSION

**Because.** Survivor DNA = a LARGE forced dislocation → reversion clearing cost (swing scale; intraday is
sub-cost, 1047/1008/1010/3008). Apply it to the **highest-impact scheduled US event**, conditioned PURELY
on the calendar (no external data): NFP = first Friday of each month → overreaction REVERSION. *Because*:
the algo knee-jerk to the payroll surprise overshoots; real-money fades it ("fade the NFP spike").
Candidate **regime-orthogonal (2018-positive)** leg: NFP surprises are noise not trend, so the fade could
work in the strong-USD/risk-off years the reversion book bleeds. Distinct from KH-era FOMC-proximity
(untrustworthy, different event) and unscheduled vol-spike reversion (3012).

**Method (obs only; no engine/P&L).** Driver `_disco_work/arc1048_nfp_reversion.py`. D1, 7 USD majors
(cached), 2010-2026. **Measurement-integrity fix:** `5ers_eet` D1 bars are timestamped at the START of the
EET trading day (~22:00/21:00 UTC of the PRIOR calendar day), so the Friday-SESSION bar carries a THURSDAY
timestamp — a naive `weekday==4` mask selects the empty Saturday session (the first run gave NFP n0 at any
threshold = the tell). Corrected to **session date = timestamp + 1 day** (DST-robust), verified NFP n=4053
(~12/yr × 16yr × 7 pairs). NFP-day net move (close−open)/ATR; FADE = −sign(move)·forward k-day drift in ATR;
controls = non-first Fridays (FRI) + all days (ALL); per-year + 2018 sign; cost hurdle ~0.05-0.10 ATR/R.

**Finding 1 — NO reversion AND NO continuation (corr ≈ 0).** corr(NFP move, fwd drift): k=1d −0.008, k=2d
−0.010, k=3d −0.007 (n1351); FRI −0.02..−0.04, ALL −0.005. The NFP move has no predictive relationship with
subsequent drift → priced efficiently at the daily scale, nothing to fade (a coin-flip base).

**Finding 2 — tiny fade is sub-cost + not NFP-specific.** thr≥0.5 k2: NFP +0.047 ATR ≈ FRI +0.039 (no
specificity), < cost. Bigger NFP moves CONTINUE (thr≥1.0 fade −0.025..−0.065).

**Finding 3 — NOT the 2018 leg, unstable.** Per-year NFP-fade (thr≥1.0,k2): positive 5/17 yrs; 2018 −0.255
& 2015 −0.196 negative; 2014 +0.923 thin-tail outlier (n13).

**Verdict — KILL (obs cheap-kill).** Overreaction-reversion FALSIFIED: NFP move corr≈0 with forward drift
(information, not a faddable overshoot), tiny fade sub-cost + not NFP-specific, bigger moves continue, not
2018-positive. Coin-flip base → §5f doesn't bite (no gross drift to exit-optimize). No engine/null/council;
OOS untouched. No new component, no canonical change.

**NEW lesson.** The highest-impact scheduled US macro release (NFP) shows NO daily-scale overreaction-
reversion on liquid USD majors — the surprise is priced efficiently (corr≈0, no specificity vs generic
Fridays). This closes the **scheduled-macro-event overreaction-reversion** lane and sharpens the survivor
distinction: the survivors exploit **MECHANICAL** forced flow (weekend rebalancing, WMR-fix, stop-runs) that
reverts *because it carries no information*; an **INFORMATION** event (a macro surprise) is priced
efficiently and does NOT revert. The remaining edge lane is a genuinely novel **mechanical/structural**
dislocation; the news/event angle is closed at the swing scale (and intraday is sub-cost, 1047).

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (pure observation). Driver `_disco_work/arc1048_nfp_reversion.py`. No
canonical change, no council, OOS untouched.

**Threads / handoff.** 2018/2014 component unfound (~20 dead routes). Sharpened prior for the next hunt:
look for MECHANICAL/structural forced flow (information-free dislocation), not news/event reactions —
those are priced efficiently. Intraday + scheduled-news + all shallow directional + pure-FX universe are
closed.

## arc_2048 — Month-end flow-EFFICACY regime persistence (can the WMR reversion's own recent efficacy separate me_long's dead 2014/15/16 block?)

**Chat 2000s · KILL (obs cheap-kill, §5d).** Full detail in `discovery/arcs/arc_2048_me_flow_efficacy_regime.md`.

**Why this arc.** The honest-exit thread (1042→1046 / 2040→2046) left `me_long` as the de-facto SOLE survivor (the one leg exit-robust IS+OOS; the book collapses to me_long-solo on the holdout, 1046). Unlike `fbr` (~10 solo-PASS attack arcs), me_long's solo-PASS was barely attacked and never post-reframe. Its binding negatives = the contiguous **2014/15/16 strong-USD block** (1012); every PRICE-trend gate to separate it failed (2014 SMA-slope, 1012 trend-filter, 1029 calendar-density, 2024 full-month window). The one un-tried regime detector: **the flow's OWN recent efficacy** (state conditioner). *Because:* the WMR rebalancing flow's tradeable strength tracks slow-moving states (hedge stock, whether the trend overruns it) → realised reversion strength should be month-to-month autocorrelated, and "last month-end reverted poorly" → the overrun regime → skip.

**Observation (D1, 7 USD majors, 195 months; canonical `_month_end_into_move` + `observe_long_capture`).** Dense monthly efficacy = cross-sectional `rev_coef = −corr(into, after)` and magnitude-aware `fade_ret = mean(−sign(into)·after)` ATR over all ≥4 firing pairs each month-end (regime proxy); tradeable me_long fires = `into ≤ −1 ATR` (n=182), joined to PRIOR-month efficacy.

**FALSIFIED both ways.**
- **(1) efficacy NOT persistent:** lag-1 autocorr `rev_coef` **+0.060**, `fade_ret` **+0.124** — BOTH inside the ±0.143 white-noise 2SE band (n=195). Month-to-month flow strength ≈ noise; the faint +0.124 is sub-2SE, unleanable.
- **(2) prior-month efficacy fails to separate the dead block:** pooled prior-ON vs prior-OFF lifts the fires (cap 0.511→0.530, drift +0.188→+0.279) — exactly the re-weighting a +0.12 autocorr buys — but WITHIN 2014-16 the conditioner is inert: prior-ON cap 0.571 yet drift **−0.074** (capture/drift disagree), prior-OFF +0.002, n=14/cell = regime-luck. The dead-block efficacy is itself noisy (2015 POSITIVE +0.079; only 2014 −0.047 / 2016 −0.206 low), so it doesn't even map to the binding folds. (Aside: OOS 2022-26 efficacy is strongly + (+0.18→+0.45), corroborating me_long's 5/6 OOS+ in 1046.)

**Mechanism / lesson.** The WMR flow's tradeable strength is not a persistent, detectable regime (autocorr ~0) → the edge's own recent outcome carries no forward info; 2014-16 is per-month idiosyncratic strong-USD overrun, un-foreshadowed by the prior month-end. **Extends arc 2019** ("binding folds are a regime property, can't lift them by sharpening entry quality") to the STATE-conditioner class — even a gate built from the edge's own recent efficacy can't separate folds whose efficacy isn't autocorrelated; re-confirms 2016/2017 (within-noise folds → within-noise efficacy) and 1029/2024 (re-weighting toward good months thins the pool 182→100 without touching binding folds). §5f does not bite (no new all-folds-positive candidate; the only place the conditioner would matter — the dead block — it fails).

**What this closes.** The **flow-self-efficacy / state-persistence** conditioner on the sole survivor — the last categorically-new regime-detection axis for me_long. me_long-solo-PASS is now closed on the regime/state axis (after exit 1012, entry-window 2024, price-trend 2014); its 2014/15/16 block is regime-intrinsic and un-conditionable from the flow's history. me_long stays the lone exit-robust PORTFOLIO survivor, NOT a solo PASS. Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO). Lever = operator path-A.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (pure observation; canonical loader + BUILT `_month_end_into_move`/`observe_long_capture`). Driver `discovery/_disco2_work/arc_2048_me_flow_efficacy_obs.py` (scratch). No canonical change, no FLAG, no council, OOS untouched.

**Threads / handoff.** me_long-solo-PASS route fully closed at the entry/exit/state axes; the 2014/15/16 block is intrinsic. The 2018/2014 regime-orthogonal component remains unfound (~20 dead routes). Sharpened prior (with 1048): the surviving edges are MECHANICAL forced flows keyed to a LARGE surprise displacement; their failure folds are regime-intrinsic and un-conditionable by any entry-time / state tell. Deployability lever = operator path-A.
### arc_1049 — failed-breakdown RECLAIM (arc 1013, best edge) on CROSSES: the 2018 universe test

**Because.** The corpus's BEST edge (arc 1013 failed-breakdown reclaim, USD majors H4, IS 9/10) fails only
on 2018, diagnosed (1014/2014/3013) as a USD-TREND artifact ("in risk-off the failed breakdown becomes a
real breakdown"). 1013 was only ever run on USD MAJORS. 2018 was a USD-SPECIFIC one-way trend → on
USD-NEUTRAL crosses 2018 was no clean trend, so the reclaim may HOLD there = the regime-orthogonal
(2018-positive) complement. Remove the named confound (USD trend) by changing UNIVERSE, not mechanism —
untested by 1013's refinements (1014/2014/3013/1040/2030), a universe lever on a deep structural edge (not
a shallow-directional re-test).

**Method (obs only).** Driver `_disco_work/arc1049_fbr_crosses.py`. Reused BUILT `FailedBreakdownReclaimLongSignal`
(K=40, shadow≥1.25) on the 4 H4-cached USD-neutral crosses (AUDJPY/EURGBP/EURJPY/GBPJPY) vs the 7 USD
majors (1013 ref); honest +1R capture + 24-bar fwd drift via `observe_long_capture` restricted to fbr fires,
grouped by year.

**Finding 1 — 2018 hypothesis DIRECTIONALLY CONFIRMED (pooled).** MAJORS 2018 drift −1.282 (the failing
fold) vs CROSSES 2018 +1.486 (n13) — the reclaim flips positive on USD-neutral crosses in 2018. The
USD-trend diagnosis is validated: 2018 weakness is USD-specific and relaxes on crosses.

**Finding 2 — cross edge WEAK overall (not usable).** Cross fbr pooled: capture 0.508 (≈coin-flip; majors
0.582), mean drift −0.128 ATR (NEG), 9/17 +yrs, 2015 −1.808 neg. §11: mean-negative = KILL. The reclaim is
materially weaker on crosses — its USD-majors strength was partly USD-SPECIFIC structure, not pure mechanism.

**Finding 3 — 2018 cross-positivity is THIN-TAIL + pair-inconsistent (decisive).** Per-pair 2018: EURGBP
+3.462 (n4), GBPJPY +2.374 (n2) carry the whole pooled +1.486; EURJPY +0.173 (n6, weak); AUDJPY −0.318 (n1)
— and AUDJPY is the only individually-decent cross overall (cap 0.566, drift +0.197). 6 trades on 2 pairs
masquerade as a 2018 edge = the thin-tail/pair-mix confound (2011/3011/3012). Not robust.

**Verdict — KILL (obs cheap-kill).** Cross-universe route to the 2018 leg closed: hypothesis directionally
confirmed (real mechanistic insight — fbr's 2018 weakness IS USD-trend-specific) but no usable component
(cross-fbr coin-flip/mean-negative; 2018 cross-signal thin-tail). 1013 UNCHANGED. No engine/null/council
(coin-flip + neg gross drift; §5f doesn't bite). OOS untouched. No canonical change.

**NEW lesson.** The corpus's best structural edge transplants POORLY across universe: failed-breakdown

## arc_1050 — liquidity-vacuum → spike REVERSION (fade a displacement after a narrow-range bar)

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1050_vacuum_spike_reversion.md`](arcs/arc_1050_vacuum_spike_reversion.md). Chat 1000s; obs cheap-kill; no engine/null/council; OOS untouched; components UNCHANGED.

**Idea.** The calendar-flow lane is closed (arc 2026: known-date forced flows are priced-in/front-run). The survivors (gap/me/fbr) need a SURPRISE displacement + a forced flow. Untested surprise-mechanical construction: a **liquidity-vacuum spike** — fade a large body displacement that fires immediately after an unusually NARROW-range (low-participation) bar, *because* a spike into a thin book is a forced/mechanical move (stop-cascade), not informational, so it over-shoots and reverts when liquidity returns. The arc-1026 overnight-inventory-reversal logic re-aimed at the intraday liquidity gradient; distinct from arc-1001 (vol-contraction BREAKOUT, traded continuation, died).

**Obs (H4, 10 pairs = 7 USD majors + AUDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY, IS 2010-2020).** vacuum = prior-bar TR/ATR in bottom tercile (≤0.713); spike = `(close−open)/ATR ≥ thr`; fade = short up-spike / long down-spike; fade-direction drift over K=6 H4 bars; NON-vacuum control.

- spike≥0.75 (n9179): fade mean **−0.028**, frac+ 0.499; control −0.026.
- spike≥1.0 (n4807): fade mean **−0.040**, frac+ 0.502; control **−0.040** (identical).
- spike≥1.5 (n1531): fade mean **−0.083**, frac+ 0.488; control −0.056.

The fade drift is NEGATIVE everywhere → the **spike CONTINUES**, fading loses; frac+ is a flat coin-flip; bigger spikes continue more (closed-ground momentum). The **vacuum conditioner is decisively non-load-bearing** (vacuum ≡ non-vacuum control). Per-pair only 2/10 positive (USDCAD +0.13 / AUDUSD +0.01 = noise). Per-year **2015 −0.099 / 2018 −0.192 both NEG** (the spike continues hardest in the strong-USD trend years a 2018 leg needs — the worst possible sign); 2016 +0.111 is the lone positive (1/11), inconsistent → isolated noise.

**Verdict KILL** (§5d cheap-kill; coin-flip + non-load-bearing conditioner → §5f exit step does not bite). Diagnosis: a self-CONSTRUCTED price-shape "mechanical" proxy does NOT isolate forced-flow reversion — at H4 a vacuum-then-spike behaves as generic momentum (continues, coin-flip, trend-year-negative). Confirms arc 1026: FX never closes → no warehoused-inventory price concession; the intraday liquidity gradient is efficient.

**NEW lesson — the OTHER half of arc 2026: a surprise displacement is NECESSARY but NOT sufficient.** arc 2026 showed a *known-date* forced flow fails (priced-in); arc 1050 shows a *surprise* displacement NOT tied to a documented forced mechanism ALSO fails (it is just momentum). A tradeable forced-flow edge needs BOTH a surprise displacement AND an identifiable institutional flow (weekend settlement gap / WMR-fix rebalancing / stop-run at a structural pivot) — do not proxy "forced flow" with a price-shape conditioner (vacuum/narrow-range); it collapses to closed-ground momentum.

## arc_1052 — intrabar (M1-path) reversal-velocity as a forced-vs-informed displacement classifier

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1052_intrabar_reversal_classifier.md`](arcs/arc_1052_intrabar_reversal_classifier.md). Chat 1000s; obs cheap-kill; no engine/null/council; OOS untouched; components UNCHANGED.

**Idea.** Fresh chat at the documented terminus (1032/1033 + the prior 1050-1051 handoff all read "frontier exhausted"). Rather than declare the apparatus dead (§2 / arc-3004 warning), I hunted the ONE dimension the corpus has never touched: the **M1 intrabar path**. Every arc runs on H4/H1/D1 *resampled* OHLC, which discards the within-bar trajectory — the timing and sequence of the high/low. The M1 bid+ask is in the corpus (the loader's source) but its intrabar information has never been a signal.

**Because.** Unified theory: tradeable reversion needs a MECHANICAL/forced displacement (overshoots into a thin book → reverts), not INFORMED (continues). arc 1050 showed bar-SHAPE proxies (range/vacuum) fail to separate them → generic momentum. But bar shape is an H4-OHLC property; it cannot see intrabar TIMING. Hypothesis: a mechanical overshoot prints its extreme EARLY and RETRACES by the bar close (liquidity returns in 4h); an informed move trends and closes AT its extreme. M1 retrace-fraction + extreme-timing are genuinely new features → could isolate the reverting (forced) subset magnitude (1050) and bar-shape can't. Natively testable on EURGBP → a candidate off-the-dollar-factor 2015/2018 angle.

**Obs (11 M1-cached pairs = 7 USD majors + AUDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY + EURGBP, IS 2010-2020, H4 5ers_eet).** Reused canonical `core.data.histdata_loader.load_m1`; replicated the canonical `5ers_eet` H4 grouping (Athens-local, group-by-date, 4h-from-midnight, left-labelled) for intrabar alignment. Per H4 bar: `retrace` = fraction of the displacement-direction extension given back by close (high = faded-in-bar = "mechanical"); `ext_t` = normalized extreme timing (early = "mechanical"). ATR Wilder(14) on H4 mid shift1; `disp=(close−open)/ATR`; `fade_k=−sign(disp)·(close[i+k]−close[i])/ATR` (positive = displacement reverted). No lookahead (features known at bar i close, entry implied i+1, ATR shift1).

- **Base reproduces 1050:** fade neg everywhere, frac+ coin-flip (thr1.0 k1/2/3 = −0.014/−0.022/−0.032) → displacement CONTINUES.
- **RETRACE quartile (thr1.0,k3) — monotone but WRONG SIGN:** Q1_lo (closed AT extreme="informed") **+0.0165** ATR/frac+0.523 REVERTS; Q4_hi (faded-in-bar="mechanical") **−0.0575**/0.482 CONTINUES. The hypothesis is exactly inverted — and the best cell (+0.017 ATR, frac+0.523≈coin-flip) is FAR sub-cost (H4 RT ~0.05–0.15 ATR).
- **EXTREME-TIMING quartile (thr1.0,k3):** early −0.028/Q2 −0.054/Q3 −0.031/late −0.015 = non-monotone, all-neg, **no separation → timing half DEAD (non-load-bearing).**
- **Coherent cell (retrace≥Q3 & extreme-early≤Q1):** SIGN-FLIPS w/ threshold (−0.025/−0.020/+0.008 @ thr0.75/1.0/1.5 = thin-tail-inversion 1050/3010 signature). thr1.5 marginal +0.008 is per-year NOISE: **2018 −0.171 (the strong-USD year a leg needs = WORST)**, 2014 −0.166 vs 2016 +0.173/2017 +0.196 alternating, no regime coherence.

**Verdict KILL** (§5d cheap-kill; inverted+sub-cost gradient + non-load-bearing timing + threshold-unstable per-year-noise cell, 2018 negative → §5f does not bite — nothing clears cost to score). Diagnosis: even the M1 intrabar path (finer than 1050's bar shape) does NOT separate forced from informed displacement; worse, the real within-bar gradient runs OPPOSITE — a bar that already snapped back intrabar has RELEASED its over-extension and drifts on, while a closed-at-extreme bar still has it "loaded" and reverts marginally (a within-bar mean-reversion that CONSUMES the next-bar reversion, not a forced-flow tell). Tiny and sub-cost either way.

**NEW lesson — the price-trajectory proxy for forced flow is DEAD at EVERY resolution, intrabar included.** arc 1050 closed it at bar-SHAPE (H4 range/vacuum); arc 1052 extends the closure to the M1 intrabar PATH (retrace + extreme-timing). A price-path classifier cannot manufacture the forced-vs-informed split the survivors (gap/me/fbr) get FREE from an IDENTIFIABLE institutional flow (weekend settlement gap / WMR-fix rebalancing / stop-run at a structural pivot). Sharpens the unified theory: tradeable reversion needs a NAMED inelastic counterparty, not a finer price-shape/timing feature — going to higher data resolution does NOT reveal a hidden order-flow edge (mirrors 1031's "go finer → variance collapses faster than the TF-invariant cost", now on the directional/classifier axis). **The intrabar lane is the LAST untouched data resolution; closing it confirms the OHLC-only charter is genuinely mined out** — only the operator-gated macro/options unlocks (NEEDS_ENABLEMENT) could re-light the EDGE term.

Operative frontier unchanged: lever = operator path-A gate-governance call (1032); honest deploy object = {me_long+fbr} 2-way (1045/1046/2045); deployable-system count = 0. Obs driver committed at `discovery/_disco1_work/arc1052_intrabar_reversal_obs.py` (pure-pandas characterization; reuses canonical `load_m1`; single-use scan, no BUILT registry entry).
## arc_2050 — London-open Asian-range liquidity SWEEP-AND-REVERSAL (does fbr's stop-run mechanism work at the documented session-open anchor?)

**Chat 2000s · KILL (obs cheap-kill, §5d).** Full detail in [`arcs/arc_2050_london_sweep_reversal.md`](arcs/arc_2050_london_sweep_reversal.md). No engine/null/council; OOS untouched; components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO; honest deploy core = me_long-solo, 1046).

**Because.** `fbr` (1013) is the corpus's ONE robust structural edge — a stop-run sweep of a VISIBLE swing low that fails and reclaims REVERTS (information-free forced flow). The most DOCUMENTED, densest intraday stop pool in FX is the ASIAN-SESSION RANGE, raided at the LONDON OPEN (the "judas swing"). This arc transplants fbr's exact mechanism to a documented level (Asian range) + a documented forced-flow time (London open) instead of a rolling algorithmic swing: a London-open sweep of the Asian low that reclaims should revert. Attractions: decorrelated-by-timing from weekend (1006)/month-end (1011/1019) flows → candidate NEW component; ~daily → THICK (arc-2017 option-B). Genuinely untested: 1047 = session DRIFT (continuous, sub-cost); 1050 = vol-vacuum spike with NO structural level (→ momentum); 2029 = DAILY prior-day/week lows. Explicit cost-skeptic prior (intraday lane repeatedly sub-cost, 1047/1008/1010/3008).

**Method (obs only).** H1, 7 cached pairs (EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/USDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY/AUDJPY), UTC bars, IS 2010-2020 (OOS preserved). Asian range = hour∈[0..6] UTC; London sweep window = hour∈[7..10] UTC. LONG fire = first sweep-window bar whose `low_bid` pierces the day's Asian-range low AND `close_mid` reclaims above it; entry next H1 bar via canonical `observe_long_capture` (honest +1R capture take-the-loss + 6-bar drift, gross). Matched STRUCTURE control = same `low<rolling-7-low & close>level` reclaim shape OUTSIDE the sweep window. Caveat: fixed UTC windows (not Europe/London DST) — fine for a cheap screen. Driver `discovery/_disco2_work/arc_2050_london_sweep_obs.py` (scratch).

**FALSIFIED three ways.**
- **(1) NO reversion — the sweep CONTINUES.** Session fwd drift **−0.0744 ATR** (median −0.0472), NEGATIVE. Price keeps falling after the Asian-low sweep-reclaim.
- **(2) Structure NOT load-bearing + sub-baseline.** Session cap 0.4444 vs control 0.4292 = trivial +0.015 lift, but session DRIFT (−0.074) WORSE than control (−0.049) = the capture/drift-disagreement take-the-loss-label artifact (not a real edge). Unconditional H1 baseline cap 0.4310 / drift −0.0608 → both fire-sets ≤ baseline. Sweep depth is a real median 0.327 ATR displacement but the reversal is WRONG-SIGN → sub-cost trivially (nothing to clear the ~0.05–0.10 R hurdle).
- **(3) Wrong-sign in the target regime.** Per-year session drift: 2014 −0.182 / 2015 −0.334 / 2018 −0.213 — continues HARDEST in the strong-USD years a 2018 leg needs (worst sign). Positive only in choppy/range years (2012 +0.081 / 2016 +0.070 / 2017 +0.061 / 2019 +0.144). Per-pair drift neg on 6/7 (GBPJPY ≈ 0); cap > 0.47 only GBPUSD (0.4789) = pair-mix.

**Why it fails (mechanism) — survivor DNA refined.** fbr works because it is FORWARD-confirming: the down-move is OVER and the reclaim catches the reversion before it starts (i+1 enters before the up-move). The London-open sweep is BACKWARD-confirming — the raid IS the OPENING of the real London session move, so it CONTINUES (the "judas swing reverses" folklore is survivorship-biased hindsight; on average the London-open Asian break SETS, not fades, the session direction). Re-confirms arc 2047 (backward-confirming/continuation structure = coin-flip) and arc 1050 (a price-shape/time proxy for "forced flow" collapses to momentum). **Key refinement:** a stop-run at a structural level reverts ONLY when it is information-free AND NOT coincident with a directional-flow WINDOW — the London open injects genuine order flow that overrides the stop-cascade reversion. fbr's swing-low sweep is a stand-alone cascade at a random time (reverts); the same pierce-and-reclaim shape at the session open is momentum (continues).

**What this closes.** The session-open structural sweep-reversal lane (the documented "judas swing" / London-open Asian-range raid) on liquid FX majors at H1 — it does not revert, it continues, hardest in the strong-USD regime. Deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** A stop-run sweep of a structural level reverts only when it is **information-free AND NOT coincident with a directional-flow window**: fbr's swing-low sweep reverts (stand-alone cascade at a random time); the London-open sweep of the Asian range does NOT (the open injects genuine directional order flow — the raid is the START of the session trend). The SAME structural shape (pierce-a-level-and-reclaim) flips from reversion to continuation purely by WHEN it fires. Extends arc 1050 ("surprise displacement is necessary but not sufficient"): the accompanying forced flow must be information-free; a session-open carries real flow and the structure becomes momentum (continues hardest in trend years). Datum: H1 unconditional long capture baseline on the 7 majors/crosses ≈ 0.431 (vs H4 ≈ 0.4877).

Deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** The structural stop-run reversal edge (fbr) is TIMEFRAME-SPECIFIC: it needs the swing low to be a SIGNIFICANT, watched level with clustered resting stops (H4/D1), which does NOT exist at H1 (microstructure noise, no stop cluster). Corollary: a structural edge's thickness is bounded by how many genuinely-significant levels exist on its native TF; you cannot manufacture more by subdividing the TF.

arc-1027's `triangle_log_residual_bp`. Three triangles (EURJPY=EURUSD·USDJPY, GBPJPY=GBPUSD·USDJPY,
EURGBP=EURUSD/GBPUSD), four resolutions (M1/M15/H1/H4), IS 2010-2020. Per cell: residual σ (bp), OU
AR(1) φ + half-life, single-cross FundedNext round-trip cost (1.5×spread + 0.5pip/fill×2 slippage +
$5/lot RT commission), and the fraction of bars where |residual| clears that cost. No engine, no null,
no council; IS-only so the holdout stays pristine (a structural-amplitude observation, not a gate run).

**Result — the L1 falsifier fires at EVERY resolution.** (table in the Tier-1 row / arc doc)
- `%>cost` < 1.1% at every resolution × triangle (max 1.08%, EURJPY-H4), far below the council's 5%
  threshold. Even charging only HALF the round-trip cost the max is 3.37% — still < 5%.
- σ (OU amplitude) ≈ 0.4-0.9 bp at ALL resolutions, vs single-cross round-trip cost ≈ 2.8-4.0 bp
  (~4-7× larger). p95|residual| (~0.8-1.1 bp) is itself below cost.
- **σ is roughly resolution-INVARIANT** — the key finding. Going finer (the council's hypothesized
  lever) does NOT widen the residual; triangular arbitrage pins the *variance* too, not merely the mean.
- OU half-life IS short and shortens at finer resolution (M1 0.9-2.1 min) — the council's prediction
  confirmed — but fast reversion is irrelevant when the oscillation amplitude never clears the spread.
- The 2σ→0 convergence trade nets positive on < 1.1% of bars even crediting the *full* reversion
  (optimistic: real convergence is partial and a one-leg expression carries directional risk between
  entry and convergence). Spread-ONLY cost (~1.1 bp) ≈ the entire 2σ move.

**Diagnosis.** The residual is dead in BOTH moments at EVERY resolution down to M1. First moment pinned
≈0 (3005/1027/2023); second moment pinned ~4-7× below the single-cross round-trip cost and
resolution-invariant. This is the convergence/statistical-arb analog of the H1 cost wall that killed the
microstructure cluster (gotobi/round-number/WMR-fix/session) — the council's flagged "knife-edge ~1.3 bp
amplitude vs ~1 bp cost" door closes decisively once the realized ROUND-TRIP cost (not a half-spread) is
charged. (The "1.3 bp amplitude vs 1 bp cost" framing under-counted cost: round-trip spend is 2.8-4.0 bp
and the harvestable amplitude is σ~0.6 bp, not the 1.3 bp tail std.)

**Meaning.** Closes menu item L1 — the LAST named explore-now thread. With M1 (1027/2023),
O1-calendar-density (1029), Q1 CB-peg (1028), G1 dollar-factor (2052/2018) all dead, the strategist
explore-now MENU is exhausted (only the O1 honestly-costed spread-z proxy is technically untested, and
it is collinear-with-density per the council, which 1029 already showed worsens fold resolution). The
OHLC-only EDGE frontier is now mined out on BOTH the directional axis (1052, intrabar M1-path) AND the
convergence/statistical-arb axis (this arc). Components UNCHANGED; operator path-A remains the sole lever
(deploy object me_long-solo, 1046/1053); deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** The triangulation residual is dead in BOTH moments at EVERY resolution down to M1 — its
OU amplitude (σ ~0.4-0.9 bp) is structurally pinned ~4-7× below the single-cross round-trip cost and is
resolution-INVARIANT, so subdividing the timeframe cannot manufacture a harvestable convergence
(arbitrage pins the variance, not just the mean; going finer raises relative cost, not amplitude). A fast
OU half-life is necessary-not-sufficient — amplitude-vs-cost, not reversion speed, is the binding test
for a convergence/stat-arb trade.

## arc_1055 — O1 spread-z inelasticity-state conditioning of fbr (the last untested O1 proxy)

**Closes O1, the last MENU family with an untested proxy.** O1 (inelasticity-state conditioning of the
surviving edges) had three collinear proxies (the council: "the same variable in three costumes — build
it once"): calendar-density (closed 1029), trigger-shallowing/depth (closed 1025), and the entry-bar
**spread-z** — the one arc 1029 explicitly left open ("spread-z, cost-trap-flagged, the only untested O1
sub-thread") and the only one carrying a genuine cost-trap, so the one where the answer could differ.

**Thesis (O1).** A wide bid-ask spread at the dislocation bar is a lag-free proxy for an inelastic book;
forced flow moves price more per unit depth → larger reversion. Concentrate fbr (the corpus's strongest
reversion edge) onto its highest-spread-z bars → higher edge-per-trade and worst-fold (a direct attack
on the per-year fold-resolution blocker). Falsifiable: per-trade R rises monotonically with spread-z AND
the top decile has a higher worst-fold. Council guard: charge the REALIZED wide spread or it's Arc-10.

**Method (obs cheap-kill).** BUILT-tools-only driver (`FailedBreakdownReclaimLongSignal` 1013 +
`observe_long_capture`), n=235 ≡ canonical fbr, 7 USD majors, IS 2010-2020. Each fire joined with its
entry-bar spread-z (causal 250-bar trailing z-score, shift1) and its realized round-trip spread cost in
R (1.5×spread / 2·ATR). Terciles + top-decile-vs-full per-year fold-sign comparison.

**Result — falsified and INVERTED on all three clauses.**
- gross drift by spread-z tercile: LO_tight +0.300 / MID +0.033 / HI_wide +0.102 (NON-monotone, and the
  TIGHT bucket is best — the opposite of the O1 prediction). Net (after realized spread): +0.264 /
  −0.010 / +0.029.
- cost trap: HI_wide median spread 2.89 bp ≈ 4× the tight bucket's 0.75 bp; cost_R doubles 0.036→0.073
  with no gross-edge gain → net worse than tight. Charging the realized wide spread is exactly what kills
  the wide cell.
- top spread-z decile (n=24): 2/9 positive years, worst-year drift −6.04 (vs full −1.53), ZERO 2018
  fires → "top decile → higher worst-fold" decisively false; same thinning death as 1029.

**Diagnosis.** For a stop-run-reclaim reversion, a wide spread does NOT mean "inelastic → larger
reversion"; it marks a genuine-stress bar where the failed breakdown becomes a real breakdown and the
reclaim fails (the 2018 mechanism, arcs 2014/2052). So inelasticity (spread-z) ANTI-selects fbr's edge —
fbr is a LIQUID-market stop-run, not an illiquidity event. Three independent failures (anti-selection +
cost trap + fold-thinning) close the proxy.

**Meaning.** Closes the last O1 sub-thread → O1 fully closed. With M1 (1027/2023), L1 (1054), Q1 (1028),
G1 (2052) already dead, **the strategist explore-now MENU is now exhaustively closed.** The OHLC-only
EDGE frontier is mined out on the directional (1052), convergence/stat-arb (1054), AND
inelasticity-conditioning (this) axes. Components UNCHANGED; operator path-A remains the sole lever
(deploy object me_long-solo, 1046/1053); deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** The inelasticity-state thesis is INVERTED for the corpus's strongest reversion edge:
wide entry-spread is a NEGATIVE signal (genuine-stress breakdown, reclaim fails), not the positive one
O1 hypothesized. The honest (realized-spread-charged) spread-z proxy anti-selects the edge AND triggers
the cost trap AND thins fold resolution — three reasons it fails, generalizing the O1 collinearity with
a directional correction.

**Frontier note (reinforced from 1054).** Within the OHLC-only charter the explore-now MENU is now
fully exhausted and every axis (directional, calendar, microstructure, regime, relative-value,
structural, convergence/stat-arb, inelasticity) is closed. The highest-value remaining work is
decision-support diagnostics on the characterized object for the operator's path-A gate-governance call,
NOT new obs-kills, until a charter unlock (operator-gated macro/options data, `NEEDS_ENABLEMENT.md`)
re-lights the EDGE term.

Driver: `discovery/_disco1_work/arc1055_fbr_spreadz.py` (BUILT-tools only; single-use diagnostic, no new
BUILT registry entry, per the arc-1053 precedent). No canonical change, no FLAG.

## arc_1056 — honest-§5f PER-TRADE bootstrap of the 2-leg deploy book (resolves arc-1043's owed thread)

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1056_honest_pertrade_bootstrap_significance.md`](arcs/arc_1056_honest_pertrade_bootstrap_significance.md).

**Why this arc (the gap).** The chat-1000s edge frontier is exhausted (1054/1055 closed the explore-now
MENU); the only remaining within-charter value is decision-support diagnostics on the characterized object
for the operator's path-A gate-governance call. Arc 1043 left ONE explicitly-owed such diagnostic: it
killed the path-A "significant mean-positive" pillar (committed t=2.66 → honest §5f fold-bootstrap t≈1.3,
CIs span zero) but flagged *"n=10 low power; a per-TRADE bootstrap (arc-2016 method) MIGHT tighten the
honest CI."* Arc 2016 ran a per-trade bootstrap, but on the COMMITTED book — the honest-§5f per-trade
bootstrap was never done. Highest-EV remaining within-charter work; zero fabrication surface (significance
arithmetic on canonically-scored trades).

**Object correction (load-bearing).** I ran it on the honest **2-leg me_long+fbr** book, NOT the 4-leg
arc 1043 used — because arc 2044 FLAG F1 established that under honest §5f exits gap & me_short flip
mean-NEGATIVE, so the honest book's best expression (and the real deploy object) is the 2-leg. Testing the
4-leg would re-answer a question on the wrong, drag-loaded object.

**Method + two Arc-10 fidelity fixes the reproduction anchor caught.** Reused arc 2044's exact honest
machinery (18-cfg registry grid × `nested_exit_selection` afp_then_mean; warmup folds 2011/12 excluded →
8 evaluable 2013-2020). Reproduced me_long +0.203% / fbr +1.001% before trusting anything. The first cut
of the bootstrap was WRONG twice and the anchor caught both — exactly why the anchor exists:
1. I first scored a single full-sample-best exit (partial-runner/SL1.5, fbr +2.92%) — the §5f-FORBIDDEN
   pick, an Arc-10 optimism; the cross-check vs the honest nested series flagged it. Fixed → nested series.
2. `ClosedTrade.pnl` is **GROSS**; the gate scores NET (cost netted at the canonical chokepoint
   `apply_cost_model`). Bootstrapping gross pnl is cost-blind. Fixed → per-POSITION
   `net_pnl = gross − total_cost` from the breakdown (a partial+runner is ONE position; legs are not
   independent → resample positions, not legs).
3. `build_fold_stats_from_run`'s `roi_pct` = the net-equity curve **sliced to the OOS window**, end/start
   − 1 — the equity GAIN realized (position EXIT) inside the OOS year over the OOS-start equity. Filtering
   positions by `final_exit_time ∈ OOS` and dividing by the OOS-start equity reproduces `fs.roi_pct` to
   ≤0.02pp (max residual 0.89pp on three slow `tp_3r`/low-trade cells where a position open at the year
   boundary carries unrealized MtM a closed-trade bootstrap can't see — disclosed; book-level center bias
   ~0.05-0.08pp, verdict invariant since point means use the gate-exact nested series).

**The statistical crux (worked through carefully, §2).** Three estimators, and which is the right SE of
the mean is NOT obvious:
- **(A) cluster / fold-level bootstrap** (resample the 8 yearly book ROIs) — this is the **textbook-correct
  SE-of-mean for per-year-clustered data.** Variance algebra: each realized yearly ROI already embeds its
  own trade-sampling noise, so cluster-Var = σ²_b/8 + σ̄²_ε/8 = the true Var(θ̂). [= arc 1043's method.]
- **(B) within-fold per-trade bootstrap** (resample each fold's positions, hold membership) — this is NOT
  the SE of the mean; it measures **per-year estimation uncertainty** (how much a single year's ROI would
  swing under a re-draw of its trades).
- **(C) two-level (cluster + trade)** — resample years AND trades. Algebra: two-level-Var = true +
  σ̄²_ε/8 → it **double-counts** the within-year variance, so it OVERSTATES uncertainty. Reported only as
  an over-conservative bound, explicitly not the verdict estimator.

**Result.** Honest 2-leg RP book (IS-frozen wts me_long 0.740 / fbr 0.260), point **+0.4110%/yr**, 6/8
pos, worst −0.211% (2018), across-fold sd 0.5481%:

| estimator | 95% CI | P(mean<0) | t | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (A) cluster (correct SE) | [+0.068%, +0.772%] | 0.008 | **+2.27** | SIG+ |
| (B) within-fold per-trade | [−0.337%, +1.167%] | 0.156 | +1.07 | ~0 |
| (C) two-level (double-counts) | [−0.406%, +1.261%] | 0.172 | +0.97 | ~0 |

Equal weights (no IS fit): point +0.6021%, cluster **t=1.91** (CI [−0.042%, +1.176%], P=0.035) → non-sig
at 5%; within-fold t=+0.94. **GUARD:** within-year sampling sd (RMS) **1.08%** (RP) / 1.81% (equal)
**EXCEEDS** the across-year spread **0.55%** / 0.97% → ratio across/within ≈ 0.5.

**What it means (the honest, nuanced resolution of arc 1043's thread):**
1. **Per-trade resampling does NOT cleanly rescue significance.** The correct estimator (cluster) gives RP
   t=2.27 (SIG+) but equal-weight t=1.91 (non-sig at 5%) → **BORDERLINE**, and the only SIG+ reading leans
   on **IS-fit RP weights** (a mild in-sample tightening that down-weights fbr's fat-tail leg to 0.26).
   The "higher power" arc 1043 hoped per-trade resampling would buy is **illusory for the SE of the mean**
   — the within-fold bootstrap answers per-year uncertainty, not the mean's SE, and the two-level
   double-counts.
2. **It corrected the object.** The honest **2-leg** book is materially stronger than the **4-leg** arc
   1043 found non-significant — confirming arc 2044 PART A from the significance angle (gap+me_short are
   honest drag; dropping them restores most of the lost t). The deploy case is **less dead than the 4-leg
   number implied** — but still **borderline**, not the robust t=2.66 the committed book advertised.
3. **The per-trade dimension's genuine contribution is a FRAGILITY tell.** within-year sampling sd >
   across-year spread (ratio ~0.5) → the per-year ROIs are dominated by fat-tail (fbr-runner) sampling
   noise; the borderline significance rests on a **lucky tight clustering** of those noisy annual numbers,
   not a thick consistent edge. (Refines arc 1023's committed "across ≈ within" to honest "across <
   within" — the honest 2-leg book is *even more* sampling-dominated.)

**Verdict: DIAGNOSTIC → KILL** (no new component; components UNCHANGED, all 4 PORTFOLIO). The honest
deploy object's mean is positive (+0.41%/yr) and **borderline-but-not-robustly significant**
(RP-weighting-dependent, fat-tail-fragile). The gate-resolution / deploy decision stays the operator's
path-A governance call; deployable-system count = 0.

**NEW lesson.** For a thin book whose per-year ROIs are carried by a few fat-tailed trades, the cluster
(fold-level) bootstrap is the correct SE-of-mean, but its significance is **fragile when within-year
sampling sd > across-year spread** — that inequality is the tell that the per-year consistency is a tight
realized clustering of noisy annual numbers, not a thick edge. The within-fold per-trade bootstrap is the
**fragility diagnostic** for this, NOT a higher-power SE of the mean; a two-level cluster+trade resample
**double-counts** within-year variance and must not be read as the SE. And: when re-deriving a thin book's
significance, test the **honest deploy object** (the 2-leg here), not a drag-loaded superset.

**Tooling.** No new BUILT tool (reused `nested_exit_selection` 2040 + `combine_fold_roi` 2006 + canonical
`apply_cost_model` / `build_fold_stats_from_run` reads; cf. arc 2016's no-new-tool precedent). Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1056_honest_pertrade_bootstrap.py`. No canonical change, no FLAG-as-code, no
council, OOS untouched.

**Three findings.**
1. **The book does NOT inherit me_long-solo's "OOS kinder than IS" lift.** me_long-solo (2055) jumped Calmar 0.06→0.31 OOS because its depressed-IS baseline (2014-16 strong-USD block) didn't recur. The BOOK's IS Calmar was already HIGH (0.26-0.36 — the staggered-trough diversification product, 2054), so there's no depressed baseline to beat, AND the other three legs DETERIORATE OOS (gap 4/6 neg, fbr dies 2022/2025, me_short neg-heavy — the 1046 collapse). The effects roughly cancel: book OOS ROI **halves** (~+0.23-0.28%/yr both weightings vs IS +0.58-0.86%), and its OOS positivity is **carried almost entirely by me_long** (RP wt 0.52, 5/6 the only reliably-+ leg). BOOK-level, vehicle-level confirmation of 1046's "book collapses to me_long-solo OOS."
2. **Book deploy-QUALITY (Calmar) survives IS→OOS ONLY under the faithful exposure cap.** cap-ON (the actual deploy book): Calmar 0.26→**0.33**, maxDD 1.50→**1.43%**, T_min 3.0→**2.4yr** (≈equal/slightly-kinder OOS). cap-OFF (monotone bound): Calmar 0.36→**0.15**, T_min 2.2→5.5yr (degrades). The cap is **net-protective and MORE valuable OOS than IS** — OOS contains clustered risk-off fires (gap+me_short fire and bleed together in 2021 & 2025 risk-off) the 2-per-currency cap trims (n_dropped 68 OOS; worst-day OOS DD 1.03→0.62% equal, 0.32→0.19% RP). Refines 2054's "cap-on improves fbr / worsens gap" to: at the BOOK level on the holdout, cap-on is net-protective.
3. **Both still vehicle-infeasible AND not-AFP OOS.** Best OOS vehicle (RP cap-ON) T_min = 2.4yr for the easiest FN 2-step (8%/10%), 4.9-5.1yr for the tighter 5-6%DD challenges ≫ challenge weeks-months (daily 5% cap never binds; maxDD/Calmar is the wall). Book is **2/6-neg OOS** (worst −1.16%, the 2021 risk-off year) → OOS does NOT rescue the AFP calendar-year gate; the book stays PORTFOLIO/not-deployable on the sole AFP judge.

**NEW LESSON.** The 4-way book's OOS vehicle geometry does **not** inherit me_long-solo's holdout-kinder-than-IS lift (2055): me_long's OOS improvement is offset by the OOS deterioration of the other three legs (gap/fbr/me_short, the 1046 collapse), so the book's OOS ROI **halves** (~+0.23-0.28%/yr) and its OOS positivity is carried almost entirely by me_long (RP wt 0.52, 5/6 OOS+). The book's deploy-QUALITY (Calmar) survives IS→OOS **only under the faithful exposure cap** (0.26→0.33 — the cap trims OOS's clustered risk-off fires, so it is more valuable OOS than IS), and degrades under the monotone cap-off bound (0.36→0.15). Net: the book is a **worse OOS vehicle than me_long-solo** — exactly why 1046 named me_long-solo, not the book, as the honest deploy object — and BOTH stay vehicle-infeasible (T_min ≥ 2.4yr ≫ challenge horizon) and not-AFP OOS (2/6 neg). Completes the deploy-object vehicle matrix on the final axis (solo-per-leg/1/2/4 × IS, solo × OOS, **book × OOS**).
