## arc_2057 — IMM-date / quarterly CME futures-roll spot-FX forced flow (KILL, obs cheap-kill)

**Fresh-eyes read.** Resumed 2000s range at 2056+1. The corpus is mature: 4 PORTFOLIO components
(gap/me_long/fbr/me_short), 4-way book mean-positive but never AFP (2015/2018 wall); the §5f
exit-honesty thread (2040-2046/1042-1046) collapsed the honest deploy object to **me_long-solo**; the
deploy-vehicle matrix is complete at every leg-count × IS/OOS (1033/2033/2053-2056) = vehicle-infeasible;
§11 verification complete; the edge frontier is closed on every mapped axis (both chats converged,
1054/1055 closed the last MENU threads). Lever = operator path-A.

**Idea + why now.** Per §5a fresh-eyes creativity (and the arc-3004 warning against prematurely
declaring "the apparatus is incapable"), I looked for a genuinely-novel *documented forced flow* that
fits the survivor template and is **untested**. The **IMM date** (3rd Wednesday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec —
CME currency-futures roll/expiry) qualified: confirmed untested (zero IMM-date/3rd-Wed/contract-roll
mentions in 6996 log lines; all 22 "IMM" matches are "immediately/immaterial"), calendar-derivable,
distinct from month-end (mid-month, no `me` overlap), and a large notional turns over. *because:* if
the roll's concentrated hedging/positioning forces a spot over-extension into the date it should revert
after, a `me`-class forced-flow reversion (or it could mark a directional flow). I held an explicit
cost-skeptic prior (the unified theory predicts sub-cost or priced-in) but examined the data agnostically
per §5b (log-dry → look at the data directly) and let it decide.

**What the data said (FALSIFIED).** Canonical D1 cache, 7 USD majors, Wilder(14) MID ATR shift1,
session=ts+1day (5ers_eet 22:00-UTC, arc-1048), n=455 IMM session bars. Cost ref: median spread/ATR
0.028 → FundedNext RT ~0.085 ATR.
- **No abnormal displacement INTO IMM:** into5 mean −0.015 ≈ Wed-control +0.022 — the roll does not
  push spot abnormally into the date (so there is no over-extension to revert).
- **No reversion — faint CONTINUATION instead:** `corr(into5, fwd3)` = **+0.10** on IMM (Wed-ctrl −0.005);
  the fade-the-into-move bet `−sign(into5)·fwd3` = **mean −0.101 ATR / median −0.087 / frac+ 0.475**,
  WORSE than the Wed-control (−0.007) → fading loses.
- **Signed drift sub-cost + thin-tail:** fwd3 IMM mean −0.059 ATR but **median +0.001 ≈ 0** (mean is a
  thin tail), « the ~0.085 ATR RT cost, ≈ the Wed-control (−0.023)/all-days (−0.004) baseline.
- **Pair-inconsistent (USD-quote-beta confound):** per-pair fwd3 5/7 mean<0 but only **3/7 median<0**
  (USDCAD +0.245 vs GBPUSD −0.237; EURUSD median +0.13 vs USDJPY −0.227) — pair-mix, not a coherent
  IMM effect (the 2009/3012/2011 tell).
- **Not the 2015/2018 leg:** per-year noisy (−0.395…+0.157); **2018 IMM fwd3 −0.01, 2015 −0.007** (≈0).

Coin-flip + non-reverting + sub-cost base → §5f does not bite (no above-cost non-coin-flip entry); §5d
cheap-kill. No engine/null/council spent. OOS untouched.

**Diagnosis — the *because* it fails (NEW lesson).** The IMM roll is a **futures calendar spread**
(long front / short back contract) → it is ~**cash-neutral in the SPOT instrument** we trade → it
creates **no net forced spot displacement** (no abnormal move into OR out of the date — confirmed by
into5 ≈ control). This is a **THIRD failure mode** of documented calendar flows, distinct from
arc-2026's two:
- (i) **sub-cost** — displacement too small (fix flows 2025/3008);
- (ii) **priced-in** — large but anticipated → front-run → coin-flip at the date (fiscal-YE 2026);
- (iii) **NEW — instrument-neutral** — the flow is real and large in its OWN instrument (futures) but
  is a calendar spread ~cash-neutral in the spot pair → no spot displacement at all.

**Sharpens the survivor DNA:** a forced flow must displace the **actual traded instrument (spot)**, not
merely exist in a related derivative. The survivors all displace spot directly (gap = weekend spot
repricing; `me` = WMR spot rebalancing at the 16:00 fix; `fbr` = spot stop-run reclaim). A
spot-FX-tradeable edge cannot be sourced from a futures-market roll.

**Threads / handoff.** Closes the IMM/quarterly-futures-roll named gap (joins gotobi 1008/2025,
fiscal-YE 2026, daily-fix 1051/3008, NFP 1048 in the "documented calendar flow → not capturable in spot
FX" series). Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO); deploy object UNCHANGED (me_long-solo, 1046); lever
= operator path-A. No new BUILT tool (used only the canonical loader + inline obs; the IMM-date helper
is a 5-line calendar function, not registry-worthy). No canonical change, no FLAG, no council, no OOS.
Within-charter reminder: the OHLC-only/spot-FX-only edge frontier is exhausted on every mapped axis;
the new instrument-neutral lesson reinforces that the remaining unlocks are operator-gated (macro/options
data, or the path-A gate-governance decision), not further OHLC obs.

## arc_2058 — Turn-of-quarter USD funding squeeze (Basel/G-SIB snapshot): a REAL quarter-end timing effect that beats null IS but is a fat-tail mirage under take-the-loss (R≈0) + frozen-exit OOS collapses + correlated with me_short → KILL (honest engine §5f)

**Chat 2000s.** Full record: [`arcs/arc_2058_turn_of_quarter_usd_funding.md`](arcs/arc_2058_turn_of_quarter_usd_funding.md). Honest engine + null; no council (not a survivor; §5f resolved it).

**Idea + because.** The one untested documented calendar flow that is BOTH directional-USD (the 2015/2018 direction the route's binding fold needs) AND structurally distinct from the dead priors: Basel III leverage-ratio / G-SIB reporting is a balance-sheet SNAPSHOT on the quarter-end date → dealers must hold USD on balance sheet AT the reporting date → spot USD bid into the turn, snapping back day-1 of the new quarter (the documented cross-currency-basis turn-of-quarter/turn-of-year spike, strongest post-2014 = our late IS). Distinct from: fiscal-YE repatriation (2026, front-run/priced-in — HERE the snapshot is a HARD deadline that can't be front-run); IMM futures roll (2057, instrument-neutral — HERE the regulatory USD demand is a SPOT balance-sheet position); `me` (1011/1019, every month-end conditional on a ≥1 ATR move — HERE quarter-end-SPECIFIC + USD-directional, not generic magnitude reversion).

**Obs (D1, 7 USD majors, IS 2010-2020; `_disco2000_work/arc2058_turn_of_quarter_usd.py`).** Hypothesis INVERTED but a real quarter-end-specific effect appeared. usd_long = long-USD per-pair return; /Wilder(14)-ATR-frac shift1. into5 (cum into the quarter-end day) usd_long **−0.255 ATR** (USD WEAKENS into the turn, NOT strengthens) vs control other-month-ends −0.038 / all-days +0.025 (year-end −0.792). fwd3 (cum after) usd_long **+0.296 ATR, median +0.251, frac+ 0.601** (USD STRENGTHENS after) vs control other-month-ends **−0.016** / all-days +0.016 → a quarter-end EXCESS ≈ +0.31 ATR, median≈mean (not a thin tail), clears the ~0.085 ATR D1 cost GROSS. Carried by the European/commodity XXXUSD majors (EUR +0.44 / GBP +0.56 / AUD +0.35 / NZD +0.18 fwd → those pairs FALL after the turn); USDJPY weak (+0.09), USDCAD NEG (−0.08) = the USD-quote-beta pair-mix tell. **Per-year: 2015 fwd −0.038 / median −0.282 = NEGATIVE** (in 2015 USD strengthened into the turn, into +0.572, and did not revert) — the strong-USD year the route needs FAILS; 2018 +0.18 is USD-strength-continuation (into +0.648), not reversion. Non-coin-flip (frac+ 0.601, gross drift >> cost, quarter-end-specific) → §5d does NOT cheap-kill; **§5f REQUIRES the honest engine** before any verdict (the gross drift could be cap/cost-gutted — arc-1017).

**Honest engine §5f (clean leg = 4 XXXUSD majors, uniform SHORT after quarter-end; BUILT `QuarterEndUsdReversionShortSignal`; driver `arc2058_engine_wfo.py`, canonical apparatus only).**
- **Pool n=168, mean `final_r` +0.012R ≈ 0, win 0.202.** The +0.296 ATR gross drift does NOT survive take-the-loss — the post-turn reversion is too slow/shallow vs the 2·ATR stop (low win-rate; a MEAN-DRIVEN displacement, not a capture edge). This is the decisive reveal (the arc-1017 pattern: gross drift ≠ engine R).
- **IS §5f exit menu — EXIT-FRAGILE, none all-folds-positive:** only `sl_only` +1.06% and `sl_plus_trailing_swing` +1.27% positive-mean; the other 4 NEGATIVE (tp2r −0.35 / tp3r −0.41 / trail_atr −0.52 / partial-runner −0.49); best 5/10 folds negative. **The IS positivity rests on ONE fat-tail fold** (fold5 +13.88%, n=4) + a 0-trade artifact fold — ex-fold5 IS mean is NEGATIVE (~−0.13%).
- **NULL:** REAL +1.27% vs fair same-side random-short −0.36% → excess **+1.62pp** (a real IS timing effect — quarter-end short beats random short).
- **OOS (frozen best IS exit `trailing_swing`, measure-once): −1.054%, 5/6 NEGATIVE, worst −3.40%** (only 2024 +5.58%, n=2 = another thin fat tail) — the IS edge COLLAPSES out-of-sample (the §5f exit-fishing trap concrete, cf. fbr-trailing_swing 2040). The IS "+1.27%" was full-sample-best-exit optimism + single-fold + dies OOS.
- **Correlation vs me_short (1019): +0.188** per-fold IS — the SAME month-end-reversion family, not decorrelated; me_short is the more robust version (7/10 folds+, far smaller swings).

**Verdict — KILL (§11 beats-null-but-net-negative).** A real quarter-end timing effect (beats the fair null +1.62pp IS) but NOT portfolio-worthy and NOT a PASS: gross drift is a fat-tail mirage under take-the-loss (pool R≈0, win 0.20), the IS mean is single-fold-carried, the frozen-exit OOS is net-negative (−1.05%, 5/6 neg), and it is correlated (+0.19) with the more-robust me_short → adds nothing decorrelated. Real-but-net-negative = KILL, not PORTFOLIO. Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO); deploy object UNCHANGED (me_long-solo, 1046); lever = operator path-A.

**NEW lesson — a 4th calendar-flow failure mode (after 2057's sub-cost / priced-in / instrument-neutral): real-but-FAT-TAIL-MIRAGE.** A gross forward-drift ATR that clears cost is NOT a tradeable edge when win-rate is low — it is a MEAN-DRIVEN displacement, not a CAPTURE edge, and take-the-loss collapses it to R≈0; the IS "mean-positive" is single-fat-tail-fold + exit-fishing that dies OOS. This sharpens the corpus's capture-vs-drift distinction: the survivors gap/me/fbr all clear cost on CAPTURE/win-rate, NOT on mean drift. Also: a quarter-end restriction of the me-reversion family inherits me's 2015-fragility (corr +0.19) and is thinner → no decorrelated gain. Methodologically reaffirms §5f's value (a non-coin-flip gross drift MUST hit the engine — here it correctly separated a real-looking +0.30 ATR drift into a net-negative-OOS KILL rather than a premature obs-cheap-kill OR a false PORTFOLIO). Closes the turn-of-quarter / Basel-snapshot USD-funding named gap.

**Tooling.** BUILT + registered: `discovery/tools/quarter_end_signals.py::QuarterEndUsdReversionShortSignal` (reusable quarter-end / year-end-only directional signal; mask + ATR + `Direction.SHORT`; canonical-scored). Soft note (not a FLAG): the IS exit menu showed one fold with n=0 trades yet +5.77% ROI (`trailing_swing`, fold 6) — an open-runner / per-year-reset book-keeping artifact in the canonical per-fold reporting; inflates the IS mean but does not change the KILL (OOS-negative regardless). Worth a glance by any future arc depending on per-fold n-vs-ROI consistency; not patched (canonical, human-gated). No canonical change, no council, OOS measure-once (holdout pristine, not tuned).

DEGRADE solo (no compensating tail); (ii) the lift is doubly fat-tail-fragile (ex-both tails ≈ flat);
(iii) IS-best partner (me_short) ≠ OOS-best (fbr), re-confirming 2054 on the partner axis. The deploy
OBJECT differs by axis: me_long-solo is the mean-honest object (1046), {me_long, fbr} is the
vehicle-best object — the two axes name different objects, completing the arc-2053 "honest-OOS-survivor
vs vehicle-geometry pull opposite" thread at the partner-selection level. Still vehicle-infeasible at
every leg-count (best T_min 2.0yr); lever = operator path-A.

## arc_1057 — TAIL-DEPENDENCE of the honest 2-leg deploy book mean (winsorize the fbr runner tail)

**Why this arc.** Resolves the thread arc 1056 explicitly owed (and the chat-1000s handoff pointer:
"tail-dependence of the deploy mean — winsorize fbr runner tail"). The corpus is exhaustively mined:
edge frontier closed (explore-now MENU exhausted, shorts/relative-value dead, leg-hunt provably closed
3021), §11 verification complete, deploy dossier mapped on every axis. The sole live lever is the
operator's path-A gate-governance call, and the only remaining within-charter value is decision-support
on the characterized object. Arc 1056 found the honest 2-leg me_long+fbr deploy mean (+0.41%/yr) only
BORDERLINE-significant (cluster RP t=2.27 / equal 1.91) and that within-year sampling sd (1.08%) EXCEEDS
the across-year spread (0.55%) → the per-year ROIs are fat-tail-(fbr-runner)-dominated, the significance
"rests on a lucky tight clustering of noisy annual numbers." 1056 named the falsifier but did not run it.
This arc runs it: cap/leave-out the fat tail and watch the mean & t. Highest-value remaining diagnostic
on the single live lever, zero fabrication surface.

**Method.** Reused arc-1056's EXACT honest-§5f machinery (CALLS canonical A1→MultiPairBacktester,
FundedNext, risk 0.005; experiment side = winsorization + cluster-bootstrap arithmetic on per-position
NET P&L only — never realizes P&L, never touches the gate). 18-cfg registry grid per leg,
`nested_exit_selection(afp_then_mean)` per-fold no-lookahead exit selection, 8 evaluable folds 2013-2020.
**Reproduced 1056 EXACTLY** (me_long +0.203%, fbr +1.001%, RP wts me_long 0.740/fbr 0.260, baseline RP
book +0.396%/yr cluster t=+2.29 ≡ 1056's 2.27; equal +0.586%/yr t=+1.92 ≡ 1.91). Then: (2) tail
concentration (top-N share of each leg's pooled net P&L); (3) winsorize both legs' positive tail at
q∈{99,97.5,95,90}; (5) per-leg attribution (winsorize ONE leg at q95); (4) leave-top-N (remove the N
largest book positions across both legs).

**What happened — the deploy mean is tail-FRAGILE.**
- **Tail concentration:** fbr 170 positions, Σnet $7,991, but **top-5 = 127% of the total** (the other
  165 collectively net-negative), top-3 = 83%, top-1 = 31%; me_long 75 positions, Σnet only $1,516,
  top-5 = 172% → the whole book edge is ~5 convex fbr-runner trades.
- **Winsorize:** RP book stays SIG+ only through a light trim (q99 t=2.20, q97.5 t=2.12); a STANDARD
  **q95 cap drops it below significance** (t 2.29→1.89, ~0), q90 t=1.61. Equal-weight already non-sig,
  degrades monotonically.
- **Per-leg attribution (decisive):** winsorize ONLY fbr q95 → t 2.29→1.90 (~0); winsorize ONLY me_long
  q95 → t 2.28 (SIG+ intact). The tail-dependence is specifically the fbr runner, not me_long.
- **Leave-top-N (starkest):** dropping the SINGLE largest position (fbr-2015 runner $2,513) → RP t
  2.29→1.52 (non-sig); top-2 t=1.11; top-3 t=0.86; **top-5 collapses the mean to +0.07%/yr (RP) /
  −0.05%/yr (equal), t≈0**. All five are fbr runners (2015 $2,513, 2016 $2,112, 2019 $2,024, 2016 $1,864,
  2020 $1,635).

**Interpretation.** This is NOT a mechanism KILL. A convex stop-run-reversal edge (many −1R stops + a few
big reclaim-and-run winners) is *expected* to be tail-carried — that is fbr's genuine shape, and it is
§11-verified honest end-to-end (signal 2034, outcome 2036/1038, the runners book exactly the next-bar
trail fills). The finding is a robustness/certifiability limit on the **mean estimate**: at n=170 fbr
positions over a decade with ~5 fat tails, the sample cannot statistically distinguish a real convex edge
from tail luck. The mean is positive in expectation but un-certifiable and un-sizeable from this data — one
un-repeatable fbr-runner regime away from zero. For the operator's path-A "significant mean-positive"
pillar, this is a material downgrade: the borderline SIG+ (t=2.27, 1056) is one fbr-2015-runner deep.

**Where it sits.** This is the THIRD, more fundamental deployment limit, alongside the two already mapped:
the **AFP-gate wall** (1032: coarsening the calendar gate yields no robust all-blocks-positive at any
meaningful granularity) and the **vehicle/Calmar wall** (2033/2059: Calmar 0.24–0.41, multi-year
underwater, prop-firm-infeasible). All three say the same thing from different angles — the corpus edge is
real but too thin / tail-carried to certify or deploy. It sharpens arc 1056 (borderline → tail-fragile)
and is the IS-side analog of arc 2059's "doubly fat-tail-fragile" OOS finding (2015/16/19/20 fbr runners
IS ≈ 2024 fbr / 2025 me_long OOS).

**NEW lesson.** For a thin reversion book whose per-year edge is carried by a few fat-tailed convex-runner
trades, the deploy mean is not just borderline-significant but tail-FRAGILE: winsorizing the positive tail
at q95, or removing the single largest position, erases the cluster-bootstrap significance, and removing
the top-5 (of ~245) zeroes the mean. The arc-1056 "within-year sd > across-year sd" tell is the signature;
this arc is its direct quantification. A convex edge being tail-carried is mechanistically honest, but at
small n it makes the MEAN un-certifiable — a robustness limit on the estimate, not the mechanism.
Winsorize + leave-top-N are the standard diagnostics; run them before leaning on any thin book's mean for
a deploy decision.

**Bookkeeping.** Disposition KILL (DIAGNOSTIC — no new component, no PASS; all 4 components UNCHANGED, all
PORTFOLIO). Resolves arc-1056's owed thread; no new edge ground. No new BUILT tool (winsorization
arithmetic on canonical net P&L — cf. arc 2016/1056 precedent). Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1057_winsorize_fbr_tail.py`. No canonical change, no FLAG, no council. OOS
NEVER touched (IS-only; book fails IS AFP → §5g firewall). Data: canonical loader (histdata_backup) +
cache; reproduces arc-1056 component/book numbers exactly. Lever unchanged = operator path-A.


### arc_2060 — leg-count optimum of the OOS deployment vehicle (is 2 the sweet spot?)

**Why / what.** Direct follow-up to 2059, which found `{me_long, fbr}` is the best 2-leg OOS vehicle
(beats solo 2055 + 4-way book 2056) but left open whether a 3rd partner improves it. Cheap completion
reusing BUILT `subset_deploy_profile.py` (no new tool): ran the two 3-leg books that CONTAIN the
winning pair — `{me_long, fbr, gap}` and `{me_long, fbr, me_short}`. §4 identical to 2059 (frozen-IS
RP weights, committed exits, OOS measure-once characterization off already-spent series).

**Result — OOS (2021–2026), RP cap-ON faithful:**

| Vehicle | legs | ret %/yr | maxDD % | Calmar | T_min | neg/6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| me_long-solo (2055) | 1 | +0.487 | 1.75 | 0.310 | 2.4 yr | 1 |
| **me_long + fbr** | **2** | **+0.697** | 1.72 | **0.405** | **2.0 yr** | 2 |
| me_long + fbr + me_short | 3 | +0.526 | 1.34 | 0.393 | 2.0 yr | 3 |
| me_long + fbr + gap | 3 | +0.602 | 1.64 | 0.367 | 2.2 yr | 2 |
| 4-way book (2056) | 4 | +0.47 | 1.43 | 0.328 | 2.4 yr | 2 |

**Finding — Calmar is HUMP-SHAPED in leg count, peaking at 2.** Both OOS Calmar (0.310 → **0.405** →
0.367–0.393 → 0.328) and OOS return (+0.487 → **+0.697** → +0.526–0.602 → +0.47) peak at the 2-leg
`{me_long, fbr}` and decline monotonically as the 3rd/4th legs are added. So `{me_long, fbr}` is the
**global OOS-vehicle optimum across all leg counts (1/2/3/4)**, not merely the best 2-leg.

**Mechanism (decomposes the hump): the two leg-count forces pull opposite.** maxDD keeps FALLING with
each added leg (1.75 → 1.72 → 1.34/1.64 → 1.43%) — the staggered-trough depth-diversification of 2054
(more legs → troughs in different years → shallower contiguous DD; the 3-leg `+me_short` 1.34% is the
shallowest fbr-containing book). But RETURN falls faster, because every partner beyond the first is a
weak-OOS-mean leg (gap 2/6, me_short 4/6 neg) whose mean-drag outweighs its incremental DD-cut →
Calmar declines past 2. The FIRST partner (fbr) is the exception: it lifts return (decorrelated 2024
+7.61% tail landing when me_long is flat) MORE than it adds DD → Calmar 0.31 → 0.405; every subsequent
partner only drags mean → Calmar falls back toward the 4-way 0.328. Hence the peak at exactly 2. This
is the quantitative resolution of 2059's "fbr is the unique value-adding partner": no *additional*
partner helps either — the vehicle optimum is the anchor + its single best tail-decorrelating partner,
then stop.

**Still KILL.** Optimum is better but the verdict does not move: T_min 2.0yr (vehicle-infeasible;
daily-5% cap never binds at any leg count), NOT all-folds-positive OOS (2/6 neg), the `{me_long, fbr}`
lift doubly fat-tail-fragile (ex-both-tail-years ≈ +0.06%/yr flat, 2059). Path-A UNCHANGED.

**NEW lesson.** The OOS deployment-vehicle Calmar is **hump-shaped in leg count, peaking at 2** — the
"more decorrelated legs = better book" intuition is FALSE on the VEHICLE (Calmar) axis on this corpus:
the 4-way book is the WORST vehicle (0.328), the solo second-worst (0.31), and the 2-leg optimum sits
between. Adding the single best tail-decorrelating partner (fbr) to the mean-honest anchor (me_long)
maximizes the vehicle; depth-diversification keeps cutting maxDD beyond that, but the weak legs'
mean-drag dominates → Calmar falls. Deploy the anchor + its single tail-decorrelating partner, not the
full book. Generalizes 2054 (depth-diversification) + 2059 (unique value-adding partner) into a
leg-count optimum. Still vehicle-infeasible at the optimum; lever = operator path-A.

**Bookkeeping.** Disposition KILL (DIAGNOSTIC — no new component; all 4 UNCHANGED, all PORTFOLIO).
Confirms + sharpens 2059's deploy recommendation: the vehicle-axis deploy object is the 2-leg
`{me_long, fbr}` (the global leg-count optimum), the mean-axis object is me_long-solo (1046). Reused
BUILT `subset_deploy_profile.py` (no new tool). No council, no canonical change, no FLAG. OOS =
measure-once characterization (§4).

### arc_2061 — US-bank-holiday thin-session reversion (scheduled-thinness gap-fill)

**Why this, fresh-eyes.** Resumed the 2000s range at 2060+1; full step-(a) read of the honest-era
corpus. The autonomous edge-hunt is exhaustively closed on every mapped axis (the explore-now MENU
item-by-item, ~25 routes to the 2015/2018 leg, portfolio densification by proof, the deploy-vehicle
matrix, §11 end-to-end). Per §2/§5a + the arc-3004 warning against the seductive "apparatus incapable"
conclusion, I did NOT merely declare closure — I picked the single mechanism whose death is *least*
pre-written and tested it cheaply.

**The idea + why it isn't pre-killed.** The weekend gap-fill (`gap` 1006) is the corpus's surviving FLOW
edge; it reverts because a CLOSED market lets a repricing gap overshoot. O1's inelasticity-state thesis
(thin book → bigger reversion) was killed only via the **spread-z** proxy (1030/1055), and the
documented reason it INVERTED was info-STRESS (wide spread = real breakdown → continues). A **scheduled
US bank holiday** is a categorically different inelasticity proxy — calendar-known, NOT stress-driven —
so it could plausibly behave like the weekend gap (revert) where the stress-confounded spread-z proxy
could not. Untested, calendar-derivable, working precedent (1006), magnitude-gated for a fair shot.

**What happened — falsified, premise inverts.** D1, 7 USD majors, `USFederalHolidayCalendar ∪ GoodFriday`
on session=ts+1day, 1179 holiday-session bars (3.6%). The premise is FALSE: holiday-session moves are
SMALLER (|move| 0.323 vs 0.500 ATR), because 24h-global FX stays liquid on a US holiday (London + Tokyo
carry on) — removing one center's participation barely thins the book. corr(move, fwd) ≈ 0-to-positive
(+0.04/+0.00/+0.01) = no reversion (faint continuation); the magnitude-gated subset (|move|≥1.0) is both
untradeably thin (n=51, ~3/yr) and mean-NEGATIVE (the rare big holiday move continues), 2015/2018 both
neg, 5/7 pairs neg (USD-quote-beta pair-mix). §5d cheap-kill; §5f never bites.

**The *because* (NEW lesson).** The gap-fill needs a genuine market-CLOSURE window (~48h of no price
discovery → a true accumulated repricing gap that reverts on resumption). A single-center holiday leaves
FX fully open globally → mild thinness, muted displacement, ordinary continuing price discovery.
**Scheduled single-center thinness ≠ closed-market thinness.** This is a FIFTH calendar/structural
failure mode beyond arc-2026/2057/2058's catalogue (sub-cost / priced-in / instrument-neutral /
fat-tail-mirage): **(v) thinness-too-mild** — the only tradeable thinness in 24h FX is an actual closure
window. It also closes O1's scheduled-thinness sub-route more cleanly than spread-z did: the holiday lane
fails not because holiday thinness is stress (1055's reason) but because it barely EXISTS.

**Threads.** None opened — this is a clean closure, not a lead. The operative frontier is unchanged: the
autonomous edge-hunt remains closed on every mapped axis, and the sole deployability lever is the
operator's path-A gate-governance call (the honest §5f deploy object = me_long-solo on mean / {me_long,
fbr} on the OOS vehicle axis, both vehicle-infeasible). A fresh chat resuming this range should weigh
whether any genuinely-novel, non-pre-killed mechanism remains before grinding further marginal closures;
my read after this arc is that the OHLC-only charter is mined out and the value now sits with the
operator's gate/deploy decision, not the autonomous edge-hunt. No engine/null/council; OOS untouched;
no canonical change, no FLAG, no new BUILT tool (scratch obs removed).

### arc_2062 — Extended-closure (long-weekend) gap-fill: does more closure strengthen it?

**Why this.** Arc 2061's NEW lesson — the weekend gap-fill (1006) reverts because of a genuine
market-CLOSURE window — has an obvious test: if a closure window is the mechanism, a LONGER closure (a
holiday-extended long weekend, ~72h vs ~48h) should produce a bigger gap that fills more reliably. The
gap modality was declared closed face-by-face at 2032 but the closure-DURATION axis was never tested,
and this directly probes 2061's mechanism on the edge that survives.

**What happened — falsified, premise false.** H4, 6 JPY crosses (the gap-fill universe), weekly-open
bars. Two decisive facts: (1) closure_h is overwhelmingly 48h (median 48, p90 52, max 76) — H4/EET
bucketing collapses weekend hours and genuine ≥72h holiday long weekends are rare (n=43 weekly-opens
over 16yr×6 pairs, only n=3 deep down-gaps → untradeably thin); (2) a longer closure produces a SMALLER
gap, not bigger (|gap| NORM ≤48h 0.418 / 52-71h 0.368 / LONG ≥72h 0.308 ATR), and fills no better
(down-gap cap flat ~coin-flip across closure length; the deeper-gap subset slightly worse on long
weekends). 2018 negative as usual. §5d cheap-kill; §5f never bites (gap is also the exit-fragile
honest-§5f-mean-neg leg, 2042 — strengthening it would be marginal even if it worked).

**The *because* (NEW lesson, bounds 2061).** The gap's magnitude is set by the weekend NEWS/repricing
flow accumulated over the closure, NOT by the closure CLOCK. A normal weekend already captures the full
weekend's pent-up repricing; a quiet holiday Monday adds hours without a catalyst → no bigger gap. With
2061, this fully bounds the gap mechanism's closure/thinness dimension: (2061) reduced-participation
single-center thinness is too mild (FX stays globally liquid, the move is muted); (2062) extending the
closure window beyond a normal weekend does not scale the gap (news-driven, not duration-driven, and
saturates at the standard weekend). The closure must EXIST (vs continuous trading — that is what
distinguishes the weekend gap from a mid-week move), but the edge does not scale with its length.

**Threads.** None — a clean complementary closure. Two cheap obs this session (2061 holiday thinness,
2062 closure duration) both confirm the OHLC-only edge frontier is mined out; the gap modality is now
closed on the thinness/closure axis in addition to 2032's faces. Operative frontier unchanged: lever =
operator path-A gate-governance call; honest deploy object = me_long-solo (mean) / {me_long,fbr} (OOS
vehicle), both vehicle-infeasible. A resuming chat should weigh whether any genuinely-novel,
non-pre-killed mechanism remains before grinding further marginal closures — my read after 2061+2062 is
that it does not, and the value now sits with the operator's gate/deploy decision. No engine/null/
council; OOS untouched; no canonical change, no FLAG, no new BUILT tool (scratch obs removed).

### arc_2063 — tail-dependence of the {me_long, fbr} deploy vehicle (runner winsorization)

**What / why (fresh-eyes, step a).** Resumed the 2000s range at 2062+1. Full honest-era read: the
OHLC-only EDGE frontier is mined out on every mapped axis (both chats converged; 2057–2062 are
calendar/closure cheap-kills + vehicle diagnostics). The single live lever is the operator's path-A
gate-governance decision. Arcs 2059/2060 established the corpus-best OOS deployment vehicle = the
2-leg **{me_long, fbr}** (global leg-count Calmar optimum) and flagged it doubly fat-tail-fragile at
the YEAR level (ex-both-tail-years ≈ +0.06%/yr flat). The 1000s arc-1056 handoff left an explicitly-
owed, decision-grade, non-colliding thread: quantify what fraction of the deploy mean comes from
fbr's convex runner tail, and re-score significance with the runner tail winsorized at +2R/+3R
(geometry-only). I picked it up at exactly the object MY 2059/2060 arcs named the deploy optimum —
the trade-level version of 2059's year-level fragility.

**Method.** `_disco2000_work/arc2063_tail_winsorization.py` (analysis script; CALLS canonical +
BUILT `build_component`/`fit_weights`; experiment-side = winsorization arithmetic only). Per-position
NET P&L (arc-1056 unit) on the committed/frozen deploy configs (me_long `sl_only`+2-bar-TE; fbr
`sl_plus_trailing_atr` double-trail = the convex-runner source), IS folds 2011-20 + OOS 2021-26.
R-unit = risk_pct·SB = $500 (linear sizing risk). UPSIDE-only winsorization `min(net, K·$500)`,
K∈{2,3,4} — **losses untouched** (take-the-loss preserved; the cap can only LOWER the mean, strictly
conservative). Recompute per-year leg+book ROI (equal + RP frozen-IS), deploy mean/neg/worst, fbr
tail-fraction, year-level cluster-bootstrap P(mean<0)+CI, uncapped vs capped.

**Reproduction anchor (Arc-10 guard).** Uncapped per-year leg ROIs reconcile to the committed-2056
numbers on the decision-relevant MEAN to ≤0.04pp (IS-RP committed 0.534 vs 0.515; OOS-RP 0.570 vs
0.606). Individual YEARS deviate up to 0.69pp (fbr's high-activity 2011/2012) — the per-position-
realized unit attributes open-position MTM at year boundaries differently than the contiguous cosim
(2056's source); this cancels in the mean and is attribution-invariant for the total-excess-above-cap
that drives the finding. Soft note, NOT a FLAG (canonical fs.roi_pct/cosim is correct; the
per-position Σnet/denom is the documented experiment-side approximation, faithful on the mean).

**Result.** fbr's edge is concentrated in few positions: IS 23/210 positions >+2R carry **20.5%** of
fbr gross-positive P&L; OOS 9/109 >+2R carry **25.3%**. Deploy-mean survival under the upside cap
(RP frozen-IS weights me_long 0.814 / fbr 0.186 = the deploy weighting):
- **OOS RP:** uncapped +0.606%/yr (P<0=0.001) → +2R **+0.310 (51%, P=0.061, CI[−0.07,+0.72])** →
  +3R +0.442 (73%, P=0.022) → +4R +0.513 (P=0.006).
- **OOS equal:** +0.766 (P=0.117) → +2R **+0.039 (5%!, neg 5/6, P=0.437)** → +3R +0.326 → +4R +0.517.
- **IS RP:** +0.515 (P=0.003) → +2R +0.255 (50%, P=0.050) → +3R +0.406 (79%, P=0.009) → +4R +0.468.
- **IS equal:** +1.025 (neg 1/10, P=0.008) → +2R +0.326 (32%, P=0.132) → +3R +0.731 → +4R +0.897.

**Diagnosis.** The {me_long, fbr} deploy mean is **substantially fbr-runner-tail-carried, NOT
broad-based.** A +2R geometry cap (touching only fbr's convex trailing-runners; every loss already
taken SL-first) removes ~49% of the RP-weighted mean and ~95% of the equal-weighted OOS mean
(flipping 3/6→5/6 neg), and drops cluster-bootstrap significance from clearly-positive
(P(mean<0)≈0.001–0.008) to borderline at +2R (RP P≈0.05–0.06, CI straddling 0); significance recovers
only at +3R/+4R, i.e. only when the runners keep most of their convexity. The positivity leans on a
handful of large convex trailing-runners — a convexity-dependent edge, not a broad win-rate edge. The
RP deploy weighting (fbr→0.186) deliberately tempers it (mean stays + at +2R) but it is still half
tail; equal-weight OOS is essentially ALL tail. **Why it matters:** a tail-/convexity-dependent mean
needs many trades / a long horizon to realize — the SAME property behind 2059/2060's vehicle-
infeasibility (T_min ≥ 2yr ≫ a challenge's weeks–months: you may not catch a runner in the window).
The two findings are one coin: the deploy object's edge is real and honestly take-the-loss-realized
but convex-tail-carried → not a challenge strategy AND high-variance even as a funded diversifier.

**NEW lesson.** The corpus-best OOS deployment vehicle ({me_long, fbr}) is convex-tail-carried at the
trade level: a geometry-only +2R upside cap (losses untouched) removes ~half the RP-weighted deploy
mean and essentially all the equal-weighted OOS mean, dropping cluster-bootstrap significance from
P(mean<0)≈0.003 to borderline ~0.05–0.06. The edge is fbr's handful of convex trailing-runners (OOS
9/109 / IS 23/210 positions >+2R carry ~20–25% of fbr gross-positive P&L), not a broad win-rate edge.
This is the trade-level identity of 2059's year-level "ex-tail-years ≈ flat" and the mechanistic ROOT
of vehicle-infeasibility — a convex-tail-carried mean requires a long horizon/many trades to realize,
so it can't clear a short prop-firm challenge AND is high-variance even as a funded diversifier.
Generalizes the 2054/2055/2059 "high Calmar from a least-repeatable fat tail" pattern to the trade
level via winsorization, and resolves arc-1056's owed tail-dependence thread at the {me_long, fbr}
object. The RP deploy weighting (fbr→0.186) is the right partial defense but does not make it
broad-based.

**Threads / handoff.** Resolves the 1056 owed thread; no new thread opened. Components UNCHANGED (all
4 PORTFOLIO); honest deploy object UNCHANGED (me_long-solo on mean / {me_long, fbr} on the OOS vehicle
axis — both vehicle-infeasible AND now established convex-tail-carried). Lever = operator path-A. No
engine-gate/null/council (DIAGNOSTIC KILL, not a survivor); no canonical change; no FLAG; no new BUILT
tool (one-off analysis driver reusing canonical + build_component/fit_weights). My read after
2061/2062/2063: the OHLC-only charter is mined out on edges AND the deploy object is now fully
characterized (vehicle matrix complete + tail-dependence); remaining value sits with the operator's
gate/deploy decision or an operator charter unlock (NEEDS_ENABLEMENT), not the autonomous edge-hunt.

## arc_1058 — TAIL-ROBUSTNESS of me_long-SOLO (the operator's honest OOS deploy object)

**Why this arc.** Direct follow-up to arc 1057, which showed the honest 2-leg me_long+fbr book's borderline
significance is fbr-runner-tail-fragile and left a fork: is the operator's ACTUAL single-leg deploy object —
me_long-SOLO (the object arcs 1046/1053 identified, since the book collapses to it OOS once fbr dies and
gap/me_short go honest-negative) — tail-robust, or also a few-trade artifact? me_long is structurally the
least tail-carried leg (high-win-rate short-horizon `sl_only`/2-bar fade, no convex runner), so if any
deploy corner has a tail-robust mean it is this one. The question is decision-relevant for path-A: if even
me_long-solo's mean is tail-fragile → no corner is certifiable (uniform conclusion); if robust → the
operator has a robust-but-low-Calmar object distinct from the fragile-but-smoother 2-leg.

**Method.** Applied arc 1057's tail-robustness battery (tail concentration + winsorize q99/97.5/95/90 +
leave-top-N + cluster bootstrap, the correct SE-of-mean) to me_long-solo at its committed honest cell
(`MonthEndReversionLongSignal(1.0,2)`, `sl_only`, SL2.0, 2-bar time-exit, D1 USD majors). Two windows: IS
(the 10 v3 folds 2011-2020 + the 8-fold 2013-2020 set for apples-to-apples with 1057) and the already-spent
OOS per-year series (`build_oos_year_folds(2021)` — measure-once characterization, 2055/2056/2059 precedent;
reading tail-robustness of a frozen series adds no selection). CALLS canonical (A1→MultiPairBacktester,
FundedNext, risk 0.005); experiment side = winsorization + bootstrap arithmetic on per-position net P&L
only. Per-fold gate ROI reproduces 1056/1053 exactly (IS 8-fold mean +0.204%; OOS [−0.63,+0.55,+0.18,+0.54,
+2.26,+0.02]).

**What happened — me_long-solo is ALSO tail-carried, and was never significant.**
- **Non-significant at baseline in BOTH windows:** IS cluster t=1.05 (10-fold) / 0.75 (8-fold); OOS t=1.66
  (CI [−0.04, +1.16] spans zero, P(<0)=0.039). Unlike the 2-leg book's borderline SIG+ (t=2.27, 1057) —
  which fbr + RP weighting supplied — me_long-SOLO's own mean never clears significance.
- **Tail-carried, shallowly:** top-5 of net P&L = 139% (IS) / 114% (OOS), the rest net-negative.
  Winsorization barely moves the (already non-sig) t because me_long's `sl_only` tail is shallow (max $699
  IS / $1,237 OOS vs fbr's $2,513), and on OOS winsorize even nudges t up (1.66→1.73 at q95: capping the
  2025 fat trade shrinks the bootstrap SE slightly faster than the mean, but the CI lower bound stays below
  0). **Leave-top-N is the decisive metric:** dropping the top-5 turns the mean NEGATIVE in both windows
  (IS −0.084%, t=−0.52; OOS −0.071%, t=−0.35); IS drop-top-1 → t=0.68; OOS drop-top-1 (2025 $1,237) → t=1.65.
- **The OOS positive mean is a 2025 story** — 3 of its top-5 positions are 2025 (the +2.26% fold), the
  solo-side analog of arc 2059's "me_long-2025 tail."

**Interpretation.** me_long-solo's appeal in arc 1046 was that its OOS mean does not flip negative (unlike
gap/fbr/me_short under honest §5f). That is a SIGN property, not a certifiability property: the OOS mean is
positive yet non-significant and single-year-carried. So the fbr-tail-fragility of the 2-leg book (1057) is
not specific to fbr's convex runner — even the shallow-tailed `sl_only` me_long has its mean carried by ~5
trades. This resolves 1057's fork on the **uniform** branch: **no deploy corner has a certifiable,
tail-robust mean** — solo (non-sig + tail-carried, this arc), 2-leg {me_long,fbr} (borderline-sig but
fbr-tail-fragile, 1057), 4-way (non-sig, 1043). Combined with the AFP-gate wall (1032) and the vehicle/
Calmar wall (2033/2059), the path-A "significant mean-positive" pillar is shown NOT to robustly exist at any
leg-count or window. The corpus reversion edge is real (mechanisms §11-verified honest) but uniformly too
thin / tail-carried to certify a mean. The deployment-robustness dossier is now complete; the lever is
definitively the operator's path-A governance call, with the honest input that no corner is certifiable.

**NEW lesson.** Run the tail-robustness battery (winsorize + leave-top-N + cluster bootstrap) on the ACTUAL
deploy object, not only the multi-leg book: the OOS-mean-positive single-leg fallback (me_long-solo, the
1046 honest object) is itself non-significant AND tail-carried in both IS and OOS (top-5 = 114-139% of net
P&L; removing the top-5 → negative mean). "OOS mean doesn't flip negative" ≠ certifiable / tail-robust. The
whole corpus's reversion edge is uniformly too thin to certify a mean at any leg-count.

itself +0.327% from JPY-bloc drift; the edge over the null only ~+0.36pp, half the headline). Best

`_disco2000_work/arc2064_nonjpy_cross_gapfill.py` (BUILT `WeekendGapFillLongSignal` × `observe_long_capture`,
honest +1R-before-SL capture + 24-bar ATR drift; gross, NOT a gate; IS 2010-2020 only).
- **Anchor — the harness reproduces the survivor:** JPY-cross benchmark (thr0.5, n=399) capture **0.5163**

  mean / −0.079 median** (both negative, median≈mean = broad) → the down-gaps **CONTINUE down, they do not
  fill.** Per-pair only 5/15 positive-drift; binding folds not positive (2015 +0.07≈0, 2018 −0.256).
- **Non-JPY crosses (thr1.0, n=337):** capture **0.4748**, mean +0.062 but **median −0.026** = thin-tail

- **Structure control (decisive): the gap is NOT load-bearing.** All non-JPY-cross week-opens drift −0.157

  ≥0.5-ATR gap filter creates no reversion. (Contrast JPY, where the same gap filter lifts drift to +0.376.)

§5f does NOT bite (sub-0.50 capture + no gross reversion drift to rescue with an exit — §5f is for
non-coin-flip entries; this is coin-flip-to-adverse). §5d cheap-kill. No engine/null/council; OOS untouched.

**NEW lesson (sharpens the survivor DNA + confirms arc-1009 from the other side).** "Weekend gap-fill" is a
misnomer for a universal closure-repricing-overshoot reversion: it is specifically a **JPY-cross risk-off
gap snap-back.** Mechanism — a JPY-cross weekend down-gap is a risk-off / carry-unwind Tokyo-session spike
that **mean-reverts** (the snap-back of a forced de-risking move); a non-JPY cross weekend down-gap is a
genuine relative-rate / EUR-bloc repricing that **persists** (mild continuation). The reverting force lives
in the JPY-bloc carry/risk-off structure (the +0.327% JPY-basket drift arc 1009 isolated as a *confound* is,

**sixth** calendar/structural failure mode to the catalogue (after sub-cost / priced-in / instrument-neutral
/ fat-tail-mirage / thinness-too-mild): **(vi) mechanism is universe-specific — a forced-flow reversion
sourced in one currency bloc's risk-off carry structure does not transfer to instruments lacking that
structure.** No 5th component (even a success would have been only PORTFOLIO — a 5th reversion leg cannot
make the book AFP, 2019/2022). Closes arc-1006 thread #112.

## arc_1059 — USD-trend-BREADTH conditioning of me_long (the deploy object)

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1059_melong_usd_breadth.md`](arcs/arc_1059_melong_usd_breadth.md). Chat 1000s; obs
cheap-kill (§5d), OOS-preserving; BUILT tools only; no engine/null/council; no canonical change; no FLAG;
components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO).

**Fresh-eyes (step a).** The corpus is at a terminus: 4 PORTFOLIO components, the 4-way book never AFP
(2015/2018 wall), the honest deploy object collapsed to me_long-solo (1046), the deploy-vehicle matrix
complete + vehicle-infeasible, §11 verification complete, and the explore-now EDGE MENU exhaustively closed
on every axis (directional / calendar-forced-flow / convergence / inelasticity / relative-value). Both
chats converged; the sibling 2000s is in the calendar-flow + vehicle-diagnostic lane (2053-2058). Lever =
operator path-A. Per §5a fresh-eyes + the arc-3004 "apparatus is incapable is seductive" warning, I tested
one genuinely-novel, mechanistically-grounded conditioner of the SURVIVING edge.

**Idea + why.** me_long buys a pair fallen ≥1 ATR into month-end (post-fix WMR reversion UP); its known
weakness is the contiguous 2014-16 strong-USD IS hole (the docstring's *because*: in a strong-USD trend the
down-move IS the trend → continues). Arc **2018** found me_long carries a real +2018 via **directional WMR**
and that stripping USD-beta removes it. So the untested refinement: condition me_long on the **breadth /
strength of the common USD move into month-end** — genuinely distinct from every mapped me-conditioner
(calendar-density 1029 / trigger-depth 1025 / spread-z 1055 / trend-SMA 1012 / quarter-end 1012-1029).
Hypothesis: capture DECREASES with |common-USD-move|; idiosyncratic fires revert, systematic continue; an
idiosyncratic-only filter lifts the worst fold.

**Method.** BUILT-tools obs (`MonthEndReversionLongSignal` fires + `observe_long_capture` honest
take-the-loss capture/drift), IS 2010-2020, D1, 7 USD majors. USD-signed 2-day move into each ME (XXXUSD up
= USD down; USDXXX up = USD up); common_usd_move = mean across the 7 majors; breadth = |common_usd_move|.
n=126 me_long fires tagged with month-breadth + own USD-signed move (systematic = sign agrees with common);
grouped by breadth tercile, systematic/idiosyncratic, per-year fold sign.

**Result — mechanism REAL + MONOTONE but NOT a worst-fold lever.**
- **(A)** capture declines monotonically with USD-breadth: LO **0.595** / MID 0.548 / HI **0.405** (HI =
  strong broad USD move = BELOW coin-flip). Drift 0.176/0.146/0.113. Unconditional 0.516. The mechanism is
  confirmed: me_long fails precisely when the move is a strong broad USD trend.
- **(B)** per-fire systematic/idiosyncratic is WEAK (both capture ~0.50-0.52; idiosyncratic n=22 thin,
  drift +0.311 vs systematic +0.110). The **2014-16 block** confirms the *because*: systematic fires (n=23)
  drift −0.117 (trend continues = the hole), idiosyncratic (n=5) +0.335 (revert) — right sign, 5 fires / 3yr.
- **(C)/(D)** NEITHER filter direction lifts the worst fold. Concentrate onto idiosyncratic (n=22 total,
  median 2/yr; 2017 zero) or LO-breadth (n=42, neg-years **4/11** worse than ALL 3/11) = the 1029/1055
  thinning death. Exclude only the worst HI-breadth tercile (§5f best version; keeps n=84, ~2/3, no
  thinning): pooled capture IMPROVES 0.516→**0.571** but per-year fold resolution WORSENS — neg-years
  3→**4/11**, worst-year −0.237→**−0.317**, because dropping HI-breadth fires removes me_long's
  directional-WMR **+2018 help** (2018 drift +0.060→−0.317; 2011 +0.155→−0.037), exactly arc 2018's finding.

**Diagnosis + meaning.** USD-breadth is a real, monotone, mechanistically-correct per-trade separator that
data-confirms the docstring *because* + arc 2018's directional-WMR result — but NOT a deployable worst-fold
lever. me_long's 2014-16 failure (systematic trend-continuation) and its +2018 help (directional WMR
reversion) live on the SAME high-USD-breadth exposure: concentrating onto low-breadth thins folds to noise;
excluding high-breadth improves per-trade capture only by removing the +2018 fires the worst fold needs.
Conditioning trades 2014-16 risk for 2018 risk; it cannot lift the worst fold. §5f exit-sweep is moot — the
failure is at the fold-SIGN level (which years are pos/neg), which no exit/SL choice moves, and me_long's
own exit is already settled-honest (committed sl_only/2-bar, 1012/2042). me_long UNCHANGED (PORTFOLIO; the
honest deploy object).

**NEW lesson.** The "edge & tail are the same exposure" closure (arc 1018 universe / 2018 cross-sectional)
extends to **state-conditioning the deploy object**: me_long's worst-fold failure (2014-16 strong-USD
systematic trend) and its best directional help (+2018) are the SAME USD-trend-breadth exposure measured at
opposite outcomes, so a breadth filter that removes the failure necessarily removes the help — it trades one
bad fold for another and cannot lift the worst fold. A conditioner can be a genuine monotone per-trade
separator (capture 0.60→0.40 across breadth) and STILL be a non-lever, because per-trade capture ≠ per-year
fold sign when the edge and its regime-tail share an exposure. Adds USD-trend-breadth to the mapped-dead
me-conditioner list (density 1029 / depth 1025 / spread-z 1055 / trend-SMA 1012 / quarter-end 1012-1029):
every state-conditioning of the surviving reversion edge either thins folds or removes the help it needs —
the deploy object's worst fold is structurally unfilterable within OHLC.

**Threads / handoff.** Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO; me_long-solo the honest deploy object,
vehicle-infeasible). Lever = operator path-A. This arc data-confirms arc 2018's directional-WMR mechanism and
closes the last natural me-conditioner (breadth). Within the OHLC-only charter the EDGE frontier stays mined
out; the next genuinely-new direction needs a charter unlock (operator-gated macro/options data,
`NEEDS_ENABLEMENT.md`) or the operator's path-A decision. **Datum:** me_long capture by USD-breadth tercile
0.595/0.548/0.405 (monotone, HI sub-coin-flip); excluding HI improves pooled capture 0.52→0.57 but worsens
worst-year −0.24→−0.32 by removing the +2018 directional help. Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1059_melong_usd_breadth.py` (BUILT tools only, single-use diagnostic).

## arc_1060 — POST-month-end TREND RESUMPTION (regime-orthogonal NON-reversion 5th-leg candidate)

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1060_newmonth_trend_resumption.md`](arcs/arc_1060_newmonth_trend_resumption.md).
Chat 1000s; obs cheap-kill (§5d), fresh-eyes novel mechanism (§5a); OOS-preserving; BUILT tools only; no
engine/null/council; no canonical change; no FLAG; components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO).

**Fresh-eyes (step a).** Corpus at a deeply-documented terminus: 4 PORTFOLIO components, the 4-way book
never AFP (2015/2018 strong-USD wall), co-sim (item E) confirmed that failure is FUNDAMENTAL not a
combiner artifact, the honest deploy object collapsed to me_long-solo (1046, vehicle-infeasible), the
explore-now MENU (M1/O1/L1/Q1/G1; S1 modifier) exhaustively closed, and closed ground covers all shallow
directional (long+short)/calendar/microstructure/RV/regime/structural. The 2000s sibling is saturating the
vehicle-geometry + residual calendar-forced-flow lane (2053-2063). The book's binding gate (arc 1020/2019):
a 5th component positive in 2015 AND 2016 without dragging 2018, NON-reversion (arc 2019 proved a 5th
*reversion* leg cannot make the book AFP). Per §2/§5a + the arc-3004 "apparatus is incapable is seductive"
warning, I tested one genuinely-untested NON-reversion construction aimed squarely at that gate.

**Idea + because.** Arc 1059 data-confirmed *why* the reversion book dies in strong-USD years — the big
down-move into month-end IS the trend and CONTINUES (me_long capture monotone-down with USD breadth; HI =
0.405 sub-coin-flip). The untested complement of the SAME mechanism is trend RESUMPTION: month-end
rebalancing is a TEMPORARY counter-trend dislocation (the reversion edges harvest the snap-back); once it
clears (the first days of the new month) the prevailing trend re-asserts → entering at new-month start in
the prevailing-trend direction should be positive precisely in the strong-trend years (2014-16, 2018) where
reversion fails — the regime-orthogonal NON-reversion leg. Why NOT closed shallow momentum (§5a):
calendar-GATED (start-of-month, post-flow-clear, not every bar), keyed to a flow-clearing market mechanism,
and the KILL/PROCEED criterion is fold-SIGN in the strong-trend folds (a trend leg can be overall-coin-flip
yet be the regime-orthogonal leg IF its +years are the book's −years), not overall edge.

**Method.** BUILT-tools obs only: `observe_long_capture` (direction-aware honest take-the-loss capture +
N-bar fwd drift), IS 2010-2020, D1, 7 USD majors. For each pair flag the k-th trading bar of each month
(causal calendar position); prevailing-trend direction = sign of trailing `trend_lb`-bar return at that bar
(causal); strength = |return|/ATR; long if up&strong, short if down&strong. Swept k∈{1,3,5},
trend_lb∈{20,60}, strength∈{0,1,1.5}ATR, hold/drift — cheap-obs robustness, not optimization. Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1060_newmonth_trend_resumption.py`.

**Result — coin-flip-or-worse, and the binding fold (2015) is robustly NEGATIVE.**
- **(A)** Sub-coin-flip everywhere: capture 0.42-0.44 in every cell; drift-MEDIAN negative in every cell
  (−0.13..−0.19). The occasional positive year-MEAN is convex-tail-carried (a few trend-tail winners while
  the median trade loses — the arc-2063 KILL tell). Mechanistically, under take-the-loss trend entries
  touch the 2·ATR stop on the pullbacks before +1R, so honest capture stays sub-coin-flip even when raw
  drift is occasionally positive → the trend side is STRUCTURALLY worse than reversion on this engine.
- **(B)** Strong-USD folds [2014,2015,2016,2018] by cell: default +0.224/**−0.304**/+0.138/+0.265; k=1
  +0.626/**−0.275**/+0.181/+0.082; k=5 +0.372/**−0.249**/+0.147/+0.467; 20d −0.674/**−0.145**/−0.109/+0.569;
  all-trends +0.205/**−0.271**/+0.163/+0.284; strong≥1.5 +0.181/**−0.213**/+0.181/+0.240. **2015 negative in
  6/7 cells** (only the degenerate hold-10/drift-5 cell flips it to a noisy +0.093 with capture cratered to
  0.32). The gate needs 2015 AND 2016 AND 2018 positive → 2015 kills it.
- **(C)** Not the me_long complement: me_long −IS-years = 2014/2015/2016; resumption there
  +0.224/**−0.304**/+0.138 → in **2015 both directions negative**, cannot cover the book's binding fold.

**Diagnosis + meaning.** The resumption is (1) coin-flip-or-worse overall (sub-0.50 capture, negative
median drift = gross-negative on the typical trade, before costs) confirming closed-ground momentum under
an honest take-the-loss lens, and (2) not reliably positive in the strong-USD folds — the single binding
fold (2015) is robustly negative across the sweep. Crucially 2015 defeats BOTH the reversion and the
trend-resumption: 2015 (CHF de-peg Jan + whipsaw choppy-then-trending USD) was not a clean persistent trend
to resume — strong moves that violently reversed — so the trend side gets whipsawed exactly where the
reversion side gets trend-run. §5f exit-sweep is moot (failure is at the fold-sign level; gross-negative on
the median regardless).

**NEW lesson.** The reversion book's strong-USD wall (2015/2018) is NOT a directional-coverage gap. Arc
1059 showed reversion fails in strong-USD years because the move continues; the natural inference "add the
trend-continuation side as the regime-orthogonal leg" is FALSIFIED here — the trend-resumption is also
negative in the binding 2015 fold, because 2015 is a whipsaw regime that runs the reversion AND whipsaws
the trend. A regime where reversion fails does NOT imply continuation succeeds; both fail when the regime
is choppy-trending rather than cleanly trending. The binding folds are hard price-structure REGIMES, not
directional gaps fillable by flipping side. Adds trend-resumption to the mapped-dead 2018/2015-leg attempts
(~22 routes). Under take-the-loss a trend leg is additionally self-penalized (stop hit on pullbacks →
sub-coin-flip honest capture), structurally worse than the reversion side on this engine.

**Threads / handoff.** Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO; me_long-solo the honest deploy object,
vehicle-infeasible). Lever = operator path-A. Closes the "trend-side complement of the reversion book" as
the regime-orthogonal 5th leg and sharpens the terminus: 2015/2018 are hard price-structure regimes, not
directional gaps. Within the OHLC-only charter the EDGE frontier stays mined out; the next genuinely-new
direction needs a charter unlock (operator-gated macro/options/COT/calendar data, `NEEDS_ENABLEMENT.md`) or
the operator's path-A decision. **Datum:** new-month trend-resumption (k=3, 60d, strong≥1ATR) capture 0.425
(sub-coin-flip), drift-median negative all cells; strong-USD folds 2014 +0.22 / 2015 −0.30 / 2016 +0.14 /
2018 +0.27 (2015 neg 6/7 sweep cells). Driver `discovery/_disco1_work/arc1060_newmonth_trend_resumption.py`.

## arc_2065 — Market-neutral cross-sectional momentum SPREAD (the LESSONS #1 relative-value frontier item)

short the weakest) — never run (arc 1000 was top-quintile long-only; 3001 directional-long drift; 2003
long-only single-leg convergence). *Because:* single-pair momentum is coin-flip (1000) because the USD

**Result.**
- **(1) Momentum spread (long winners/short losers) gross-NEGATIVE coin-flip in every cell** (mean
  −0.0846/−0.0230/−0.1858/−0.2193/−0.0662 %/rebalance across 60-5-4 / 20-5-4 / 120-10-4 / 60-20-3 /
  60-5-3; frac_pos 0.50±0.02). The cross-section REVERTS not trends: long-leg fwd drifts DOWN, short-leg

  negative-overall coin-flip). Hypothesis FALSIFIED — even in trending-USD years the weekly relative
  ranking whipsaws.
- **(2) The reversal mirror (long losers/short winners) looked alive.** primary 60/5/4: mean +0.0846% but
  median −0.0036% = fat-tail mirage. **Monthly 60/20/3: mean +0.2193% ≈ median +0.2503% (BROAD)**,

  LONG legs (buy losers) capture **0.4212** drift −0.064 (losers CONTINUE, no reversion to harvest);

## arc_1061 — Japanese FISCAL-YEAR-END (Mar 31) JPY REPATRIATION seasonal

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1061_jpy_fiscal_yearend_repatriation.md`](arcs/arc_1061_jpy_fiscal_yearend_repatriation.md).
Chat 1000s; obs cheap-kill (§5d), fresh-eyes documented-mechanism (§5a); OOS-preserving; BUILT tools only;
no engine/null/council; no canonical change; no FLAG; components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO).

**Fresh-eyes (step a).** Pulled main (highest in-range 1060 → resume 1061; no STOP). The corpus is at a
**rigorously-proven** terminus, not a soft one: the 5th-leg route is structurally closed (arc **2022**
weighting-dilemma — even the strongest +2015&+2018 maximally-decorrelated leg, shock-continuation 3019,
is throttled to a tiny honest weight; the weight that gives AFP is overfit), the densification route

P(AFP) plateaus ~0.30 unreachable at any N), and the EDGE frontier is closed across ~60 arcs on every

interrogated the strongest remaining EDGE candidate (long-vol/convexity as the regime-orthogonal leg) and
found it **already closed by 2022** (shock-continuation IS that leg). I then tested one documented
mechanism the corpus has genuinely never touched, with a *because* independent of the binding folds.

**Idea + because.** Japan's fiscal year ends Mar 31 → institutions repatriate foreign earnings → buy JPY
→ JPY-quote crosses (XXXJPY) should FALL into late March → SHORT XXXJPY. A cited recurring FX seasonal,
DISTINCT from the corpus's generic monthly month-end (me fires every month on USD majors). Clean (not
fold-fished): calendar-gated, currency-specific, documented mechanism, decisive control = March vs other
months.

**Method.** BUILT `observe_long_capture` (direction-aware honest take-the-loss capture + fwd-drift), IS
2010-2020, D1, 7 JPY-quote crosses (USDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY/AUDJPY/NZDJPY/CADJPY/CHFJPY). Window = calendar
day-of-month ≥ 24 in March (last ~week; day-of-month known AT the bar → causal). Controls: (B) same
late-window in non-March months; (D) the LONG direction; (E) day≥20 / longer hold. Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1061_jpy_fiscal_yearend_repatriation.py`.

**Result — textbook direction BACKWARD; reverse tilt real-but-sub-capturable.**
- **(A)** Late-March SHORT XXXJPY: **capture 0.240 (≪0.50), 0/7 pairs**, drift −0.288 (short-signed →
  XXXJPY actually ROSE = JPY WEAKENED, the OPPOSITE of the repatriation narrative).
- **(B)** It IS March-specific — in REVERSE: March-excess short drift **−0.213** vs other late-months
  (day≥20: −0.285) → a genuine **March-specific JPY-WEAKNESS tilt ≈+0.17 ATR**, consistent with the
  empirical literature that repatriation is forward-HEDGED/pre-positioned, so spot JPY *weakens* into FYE
  (plus April outward-investment).
- **(D)** The reverse (LONG XXXJPY) drift +0.251, 7/11 years — but **capture only 0.327** (sub-coin-flip:
  take-the-loss stops the long at 2·ATR before +1R two-thirds of the time), **convex-tail-carried** (2011
  +2.35 / 2013 +1.14 dominate; 2016 −1.50 / 2017 −0.94 / 2020 −0.41 negative — the arc-2011/2063 thin-tail
  tell), thin (1/yr → un-scalable, arc-1017/3019), and does NOT cover the binding folds (2015 +0.002,
  2016 **−1.497**, 2018 +0.362).

**Diagnosis + meaning.** A documented institutional calendar-flow seasonal, honestly tested, is (1)
directionally backward to its own textbook narrative in spot (the repatriation is pre-hedged → spot JPY
weakens into Mar 31, doesn't strengthen) and (2) the real reverse tilt is sub-capturable under
take-the-loss (0.327), thin, convex-tail-carried, and binding-fold-blind. §5f exit-sweep moot (fails at
capturability/fold-sign, not exit).

**NEW lesson.** Documented discrete calendar-FLOW seasonals on liquid FX are arbitraged to
sub-cost/sub-capturable at the honest take-the-loss gate — **and the narrative DIRECTION is not even
reliable**: JPY-FYE "repatriation buys JPY" is *backward* in spot once hedging/pre-positioning is counted,

deploy and does not cover the binding folds. Adds JPY-FYE repatriation to the mapped-dead calendar-flow
family (gotobi 1008 / round-number 1010 / month-end-fix 3008 / turn-of-month 1005 / IMM-roll 2057 /
quarter-end 2058) — the closed-ground "forward drift ≈ cost everywhere" extends to currency-specific
institutional-flow seasonals.

## arc_1062 — DIRECTION-AGNOSTIC COMPRESSION-EXPANSION convexity leg (the long-vol 5th-leg candidate)

Full record: [`arcs/arc_1062_compression_expansion_convexity.md`](arcs/arc_1062_compression_expansion_convexity.md).
Chat 1000s; obs cheap-kill (§5d), fresh-eyes novel construction (§5a); OOS-preserving; BUILT tools only;
no engine/null/council; no canonical change; no FLAG; components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO).

**Fresh-eyes (step a).** Pulled main (highest in-range 1061 → resume 1062; no STOP). Read protocol +
both log tiers (all ranges) + LESSONS + registry. The within-charter terminus is rigorously proven and I
RE-CHECKED rather than inherited it: 4 PORTFOLIO components, book never AFP (binding folds 2015/2018),
co-sim confirms the failure is fundamental; the 5th-leg route is closed by arc **2022** (weighting
dilemma) and path-B by arc **3021** (portfolio-math variance floor); and I independently re-confirmed
that EVERY dispatch frontier item is KILL by data — short-side asymmetries (up-gap short 1016; fbr-mirror
short 1014/2011/3011/1035), relative-value/market-neutral (cointegration 2010, laggard 2003 — doubled-cost
wall), the USD-neutral-cross dollar-factor escape (1018/2049/2064), and the calendar-flow family
(1005/1008/1010/2057/2058/3008/1061). Per §2/§5a + the arc-3004 "apparatus is incapable is seductive"
warning, I did NOT declare done by argument: arc 1061 *asserted* the long-vol/convexity leg is "closed by
2022," but 2022 only tested the DIRECTIONAL construction (shock-continuation). The DIRECTION-AGNOSTIC
convexity construction (buildable only since shorts were verified-enabled, PR #273) had never been tested
— so I tested it empirically.

**Idea + because.** The two binding folds 2015 (CHF-de-peg whipsaw) and 2018 (strong-USD trend) SHARE
elevated realized vol. A long-vol/CONVEXITY leg that does NOT pick direction — a tight coil that breaks,
taken in WHICHEVER direction it breaks (long up-break, short down-break; a single-leg straddle analog) —
SHOULD be positive in BOTH regardless of direction = the regime-orthogonal complement of the reversion
book. Distinct from long-only arc-1001 (this is the direction-agnostic version shorts unlock) and from
arc-2022 shock-continuation (that is post-confirmation directional; this enters AT the coil break BEFORE
the expansion forms). KILL/PROCEED = the regime-orthogonal test (reliably +ve in BOTH 2015 AND 2018), not
overall edge.

**Method.** BUILT tools only. Causal compression-break per pair at bar t: coil width = (12-bar high-low
range)/ATR ≤ 3.5 (tight); up-break = close_t > prior-12-bar high (shift(1)); down-break = close_t <
prior-12-bar low. `observe_long_capture` (direction-aware honest take-the-loss capture + fwd drift) run
long on up-break bars + short on down-break bars via `restrict`; IS 2010-2020, H4, 7 USD majors; levers
swept for regime-orthogonality (not optimization). Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1062_compression_expansion_convexity.py`.

**Result — gross-negative, sub-null, no compression gradient, binding folds not robustly covered.**
- **(A) FALSIFIED.** Tight-coil default (coil12/≤3.5ATR/break12/hold24): n=5870, **capture 0.4535 — BELOW
  the ~0.49 unconditional H4-majors null** (worse than random entry), drift_mean −0.069, mean-of-yr −0.083
  (gross-negative typical trade pre-cost). Binding folds NOT robustly covered: 2015 **+0.029** (marginal),
  2018 **+0.066** default but **−0.181** in the longer-hold cell (sign-flips across cells = not real); the
  other strong-USD years are strongly negative (2014 **−0.397**, 2016 **−0.191**).
- **(B) FALSIFIED — no compression gradient.** Splitting default fires by actual coil tightness:
  tight-tercile drift −0.050 vs loose −0.129, BOTH negative; tightness buys no positive edge. The
  tight-coil break is the classic false-break trap.
- **(C) FALSIFIED — no regime concentration.** Strong-USD folds 2014 −0.40 / 2015 +0.03 / 2016 −0.19 /
  2018 +0.07 — dominated by negatives.

**Diagnosis + meaning.** The construction that *should* be positive in both high-vol binding folds is
gross-negative, sub-null, gradient-less, and covers neither 2015 nor 2018 robustly. Reason (sharpening
arc 1060): high realized vol ≠ expansion-convexity payoff under take-the-loss. 2018's vol is a persistent
ONE-DIRECTIONAL trend whose pullbacks stop-run the straddle's wrong-side entries to −1R (2014/2016 same
trend-grind); only a genuine BIDIRECTIONAL shock (2015 de-peg) marginally rewards the straddle, thinly.
§5f moot — the entry is a sub-null coin-flip, so it doesn't even trigger the mandatory exit sweep; the
failure is at capturability/fold-sign, not exit.

**NEW lesson.** "Both binding folds are high-vol ⇒ a direction-agnostic convexity leg covers both" is
FALSE. Even a straddle-analog does not systematically pay in the strong-USD high-vol years, because
2018-class vol is DIRECTIONAL-TREND vol (one-way move + stop-running pullbacks whipsawing the wrong side
to −1R), not the bidirectional expansion vol a straddle needs. This closes the long-vol/convexity 5th-leg
route from the CONSTRUCTION side, complementing arc 2022's closure from the WEIGHTING side (which used the
directional shock-continuation): BOTH the directional (2022) and direction-agnostic (this arc) long-vol
constructions fail to be the +2015&+2018 regime-orthogonal leg. Reconfirms the dispatch's own prediction
that shorts don't revive closed breakout (the symmetric direction-agnostic breakout is sub-null capture
0.45 — the long base's coin-flip mirrored). The 2015/2018 wall is a TWO-DIFFERENT-REGIME barrier
(whipsaw-shock vs directional-trend), not a single-volatility-exposure gap fillable by one convexity leg.

**Threads / handoff.** Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO; me_long-solo the honest deploy object,
vehicle-infeasible). Lever = **operator path-A** (gate-governance on a sound mean-positive ~3-bet book —
1023/2021/3021) **OR a charter unlock** (`NEEDS_ENABLEMENT.md`). This arc empirically closes the last
argued-but-untested EDGE candidate (long-vol/convexity) from the construction side, so the within-charter
terminus is now proven on BOTH the weighting axis (2022) and the construction axis (this arc). **Datum:**
direction-agnostic tight-coil break (H4 USD majors) capture 0.4535 sub-null, drift −0.069, mean-of-yr
−0.083; binding 2015 +0.029 / 2018 +0.066→−0.181 (sign-flips); 2014 −0.40 / 2016 −0.19; no compression
gradient (tight −0.05 vs loose −0.13). Driver `discovery/_disco1_work/arc1062_compression_expansion_convexity.py`
(BUILT tools only, single-use; no new BUILT tool registered).

### arc_1063 — POWER AUDIT of the all-folds-positive discovery judge

**Chat 1000s. Full record:** [`arcs/arc_1063_judge_power_audit.md`](arcs/arc_1063_judge_power_audit.md).
Light generative council convened (`/llm-council-discovery`); no council-on-result (a measurement
characterizing a measurement, cf. 1023). Disposition **KILL** (diagnostic; no new component; the
strict gate is unchanged). **No price / no engine / no OOS touched — pure statistics of the judge.**

**Why this arc (the stuck-state).** Resumed the 1000s loop at 1063 with genuinely fresh eyes (honest-era
log only). Synthesis: 4 PORTFOLIO survivors (gap/me_long/me_short/fbr), book fails all-folds blocked
combination-invariantly by 2015 (only fbr +) & 2018 (only me_long +), item-E co-sim FUNDAMENTAL, book
mean borderline/tail-fragile under honest §5f (1023/1056/1057/1058/2042). This session's whole frontier
is dead: both dispatch short leads (up-gap 1016/2013; fbr-mirror 1014/2009/2011/3011), explore-now MENU
(M1 1027, O1 1029/1025/1055, L1 1054, Q1 peg-defense 1028, G1 2052, S1), me/fbr-on-crosses (2049/1021/3018),
intraday session (3016/2050/1026), calendar-flow seasonals (…/JPY-FYE 1061), the 5th regime-orthogonal leg
(~22 routes, 1059–1062). My own brainstorm (me-on-crosses, first-of-month inflow, turn-of-year,
cross-pair cascade) each resolved to already-tested ground → a real idea-fork → §5b LIGHT council.

**Council (light, generative).** Five lenses proposed C=cross-pair cascade-fade, D=mechanism-anchored
(phase-locked) folds, A=export fbr's USD-factor-idiosyncratic separator as a shared cross-leg veto,
E=spot short-gamma (self-refuting), B=continuation/positive-skew shapes. The load-bearing output was the
**peer-review convergence (4/5, raised by NO lens):** nobody questioned the JUDGE's statistical power —
the all-folds-per-year gate may reject true positive-EV edges by sampling noise, so "exhaustion" could be
a measurement artifact. Chairman: **investigate-the-judge-first** (cheaper than any arc, dual honest
outcome); E unanimously parked; lens-A's premise challenged (2015/2018 is a SIGN conflict not co-located
noise → a symmetric veto can't make a year prefer the leg it rejects). CC committed the redirection.

**Method.** BUILT `discovery/tools/judge_power_audit.py`: build synthetic per-fold `FoldStats` of KNOWN
EV → feed the **canonical** `judge_all_folds_positive` (rule = every roi_pct>0); fold COUNTS from
canonical `build_v3_folds` (IS) + `build_oos_year_folds` (OOS). A year's ROI~(μ,σ) ⇒ P(year>0)=Φ(S),
S=per-year Sharpe=μ/σ of the annual series; folds ~independent (distinct scored years) ⇒
P(all-K-pos)=Φ(S)^K. Validated: (i) canonical-judge MC ≡ vectorized rule ≡ analytic; (ii) **independent
cross-check — at the book's published (μ=0.624%, σ=0.741%, K=10) backbone P=0.108 ≡ arc-1023's
per-trade/fold BOOTSTRAP 0.113** (different method/chat; also proves fold-dependence negligible);
(iii) convex SL-honest per-trade MC for the fat-tail penalty. Driver
`discovery/_disco1_work/arc1063_judge_power_audit.py`. Determinism `default_rng(42)`.

**Results.** K_IS=10, K_OOS=6, K_JOINT=16. Per-year Sharpe to PASS: 50%→1.50 (IS-10)/1.72 (joint-16);
**80%→2.01 (IS-10)/2.20 (joint-16)**; 95%→2.57/2.73. P(all-folds) at realistic Sharpe: **0.84 (book)→
0.107 IS / 0.028 joint**; 1.0→0.063 joint; 1.5→0.33 joint; 2.0→0.69 joint. Survivors: me_long IS Sharpe
+0.254 (P=0.017), OOS +0.501 (P=0.110); book 0.842 (P=0.108≡1023). Fat-tail penalty real but SECONDARY
(×1.1–1.2 at 12–25 trades/yr; CLT normalizes the year-sum — low Sharpe, not skew, is the binding term).

**Interpretation (both honest halves).** (1) The all-folds-positive gate is a **≈Sharpe-2/year
CONSISTENCY screen** — world-class consistency for an 80% pass over 16 folds; thin real edges (Sharpe
0.25–0.84) clear it only 2–11% of the time. (2) ⇒ the **0/90 PASS rate (0 PASS / 7 PORTFOLIO / 146 KILL)
is consistent with the gate's LOW POWER, not only edge-absence** — running ~90 thin candidates through a
Sharpe-2 screen is *expected* to yield 0 passers even with several real deployable-magnitude edges.
REFRAMES "frontier exhausted": the corpus shows no edge strong enough to beat a Sharpe-2 screen — weaker
than "no deployable edge exists." (3) BUT low power does NOT manufacture deployability — the actual
binding test is certifiable-MEAN (mean+CI/tail-robustness), separately judged MARGINAL (1023 t=2.66
committed → borderline/non-sig + tail-fragile under honest §5f). The audit's service is to **separate two
conflated things:** "fails all-folds" (a low-power consistency screen thin survivors were always going to
fail) vs "mean not certifiable" (the real deployment obstacle). Both → operator **path-A**. (4) Strict
gate STAYS the gate (not loosened); the honest deployable verdict runs through certifiable-mean.

**NEW lesson.** The all-folds-positive-per-year discovery judge is a ≈Sharpe-2/year consistency screen
(2.0 per-year Sharpe for an 80% pass over 16 folds; 1.7 for 50%). Real positive-mean edges at the
survivors' thinness (Sharpe 0.25–0.84) pass only ~2–11% of the time → a 0/N all-folds result on THIN
candidates is weak evidence of edge-absence; it is mostly the screen's low power. SEPARATE "fails
all-folds" (consistency screen) from "mean not certifiable" (the deployment test); `judge_power_audit.py`
can now put a power CI on any future KILL (real KILL vs power KILL). Cross-validated vs arc-1023's
independent bootstrap.

**Forward threads (council-surfaced, NOT executed — for a future arc).** (a) **lens-A correlation-vs-sign
crux:** are me_long's 2018 losing bars predominantly USD-factor-wide (cheap panel query)? Settles whether
a shared USD-factor veto could rescue the book or whether 2015/2018 is an irreducible SIGN conflict.
(b) **lens-B continuation/positive-SKEW shapes:** the corpus tested ONLY reversion; continuation shapes

pre-registered guard (median-per-fold + tail-removed expectancy BEFORE believing, lest 2025/top-5
tail-luck be relabeled "positive skew").

**Tooling.** BUILT + registered `discovery/tools/judge_power_audit.py` (EXPERIMENT tool — statistics over
the canonical judge; no canonical-core change). **FLAGS:** none. Components UNCHANGED (all 4 PORTFOLIO);

## arc_2069 — Terminal re-confirmation, additive: the dynamic / regime-conditioned ALLOCATION family is closed

**Chat 2000s.** Fresh bootstrap, resumed 2068+1. No new edge. Full step-(a) honest-era re-read (protocol
v1.1; Tier-1 ledger arc 0→2068 across all three chats + recent Tier-2 2055–2068 + sibling 1052/1062;
LESSONS incl. Closed-ground prior; TOOL_REGISTRY; NEEDS_ENABLEMENT; DISCOVERY_DIRECTION). No
`discovery/STOP` (checked). OOS NEVER touched. Fresh eyes (honest-era only).

**Why not a verbatim repeat of 2066/2067/2068.** Those ran a broad sweep (2066), tied the binding leg to
M/O (2067), and re-weighted the enablement queue by §5f (2068). This arc does two things neither did: it
re-verifies *this chat's own dispatch frontier list* item-by-item against the record (rather than
inheriting the closure wholesale), and it closes a specific combination-side rebuttal — the dynamic
regime-conditioned allocator — that is asserted-dead but never *derived* dead.

**Dispatch frontier re-verified (each named item → recorded honest-era closure):** up-gap weekend SHORT →
gap family (1016/2013/2032/2062/2064), gap is a PORTFOLIO leg, short legs KILL; **failed-breakdown up-sweep
SHORT (fbr's mirror, the dispatch's flagged "arguably stronger leg") → arcs 2011 + 3011, BOTH KILL** —
capture coin-flip 0.47–0.51 vs fbr-long 0.55–0.61, the pooled structure-control "pass" is a thin-tail /
pair-mix confound (AUDUSD/USDJPY outliers; NEG excluding them) and NEG in 2018; fbr-long has no tradeable
short mirror across 3 constructions (1014/2009/2011·3011); relative-value / market-neutral → 2003/2010/2065
(relative perf is momentum/coin-flip); regime-orthogonal +2015/+2018 leg (2006 spec) → OHLC-unreachable
(2067, needs M/O); deep multi-factor directional either side → 1013 the one win (already a component),

property is reversal-specific). Shorts are merged (PR #273) and me_short is already a component, so "shorts
are open" is already priced into the terminus — the dispatch list (written pre-merge) is fully run.

**The additive contribution — derive (not assert) the dynamic-allocation closure.** The path-B-closed case
has three recorded closures of the *combination* question: static convex weights (no fixed weighting
passes, 2008/1015/1020/2022 + co-sim item E); densification (more decorrelated legs can't satisfy AFP,
3021, a shared factor floors book variance); and time-varying SIZING (an ex-ante vol-target *scalar* on
total exposure is fold-sign-blind, `corr(leverage, daily P&L)≈0`, 1036). The natural remaining rebuttal —
*"a smart allocator could rotate the relative WEIGHTS between the two opposite-demand legs by an ex-ante
regime read: hold fbr in 2015-type conditions, me_short in 2018-type"* — is **distinct** from 1036 (which
scales one scalar, not the inter-leg mix) and was only *asserted* dead (NEEDS_ENABLEMENT item W, "dynamic
weights, not a route to PASS"). I close it by composition, two independent sufficient arguments:
1. **The two opposite-demand folds are ex-ante observationally CO-REGIME.** 2015 and 2018 are both
   risk-off / strong-USD / vol-expansion years (2067); the only feature separating them is whipsaw-vol
   (2015) vs directional-trend-vol (2018) (1062) — and that trend-vs-whipsaw axis is exactly the regime
   measure LESSONS records as failing / "strong-trend regimes invert." So no ex-ante regime variable cleanly
   routes weight to fbr in 2015 and me_short in 2018.
2. **Even granting a perfect separator, the favor-this-leg-this-fold MAPPING is fold-sign lookahead.** You
   only know "2015 wants fbr, 2018 wants me_short" from the per-fold *outcomes*; with **n = 2 binding folds**
   any regime rule that "works" is fit to two points = arc-1021 paint, indistinguishable from luck OOS. This
   generalizes 1036's fold-sign-blindness from a scalar to a conditioned allocator (conditioning allocation
   on which leg pays which fold = conditioning on the label).

I deliberately did NOT run a "best ex-ante regime variable separating the fold set" data fit — at n = 2
binding folds that fit is overfit-guaranteed and would *manufacture* a spurious separation, the exact
arc-3004 / arc-1021 failure mode. The honest instrument is the composition argument, as 3021 settled
densification with portfolio math rather than a leg hunt. ⇒ the combination question is now closed on all
three axes a deployer would try — static weights, more legs, AND dynamic/regime-conditioned allocation —
because the obstruction (two opposite-demand folds inside one observable regime) is invariant to how you
allocate among the legs you have. The only escape remains a genuinely NEW leg that is itself +2015 AND
+2018, which 2067 showed is OHLC-unreachable (M / O). §5f doesn't bite (no new entry; combination/allocation
closure, not an entry test); §5d cheap-kill class.

**Verdict — KILL** (no new component; terminal re-confirmation + additive dynamic-allocation closure +
graceful handoff). Sole lever = operator path-A gate-governance call and/or charter unlock M (macro) / O
(options). Per §8 conservative, non-grinding, non-blocking; per §10 graceful handoff.

**NEW lesson.** A thin mean-positive PORTFOLIO whose AFP failure is two folds with *opposite* leg-demands
inside a *single observable regime* cannot be rescued by ANY allocation scheme over the existing legs — not
static weights, not densification, and not an ex-ante regime-conditioned allocator that rotates between the
legs. The dynamic-allocator rebuttal dies twice over: (i) the opposite-demand folds are ex-ante co-regime
(no separating signal — the only separator, trend-vs-whipsaw, is the regime axis that inverts), and (ii)
with n = 2 binding folds the favor-this-leg-this-fold mapping is fold-sign lookahead / 2-point paint. This
generalizes the 1036 vol-target SIZING closure to the full dynamic-ALLOCATION family, completing the
combination-side closure (static 2008/1015/2022 + densify 3021 + dynamic here). The arc-3004 trap is avoided
by closing via composition rather than a spurious n = 2 regime fit.

**Bookkeeping.** Components UNCHANGED (4 PORTFOLIO; me_long sole OOS-mean-robust anchor; {me_long,fbr}
vehicle-optimum). Deploy object UNCHANGED. Deployable-system count = 0. No new BUILT tool; no canonical
